sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusikiliza na Kujibu (Theme 1: Usafi wa kibinafsi)
learning_experiences: kutambua vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kusikiliza mazungumzo,
kutambua vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kujibu mazungumzo,
kusikiliza mazungumzo kuhusu suala lengwa katika kifaa cha kidijitali huku akizingatia vipengele vya kuboresha usikilizaji wa mazungumzo,
kusikiliza na kujibu mazungumzo ipasavyo,
kuigiza mazungumzo (k.v. ya simu) kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kuzingatia vipengele vifaavyo vya kusikiliza na kujibu mazungumzo,
kushiriki mazungumzo na mzazi au mlezi kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kuzingatia vipengele vifaavyo vya kusikiliza na kujibu mazungumzo.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, unaposikiliza mazungumzo unapaswa kuzingatia nini ili kupata ujumbe unaowasilishwa?
Unazingatia nini unapomjibu mtu katika mazungumzo?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kuchangia ipasavyo katika shughuli za ujifunzaji kuhusu kusikiliza na kujibu mazungumzo.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusikilizia mazungumzo mbalimbali na kutambua vipengele vya kusikiliza na kuzungumza vilivyozingatiwa.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anaposikiliza mazungumzo na kuyajibu ipasavyo bila woga. Pia anapochangia katika shughuli ya kikundi.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji. Pia anapoheshimu zamu ya wenzake katika mazungumzo.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali anavyotumia katika mazungumzo.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki na kuchangia katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.pcis: Usafi wa kibinafsi: mwanafunzi anaposikiliza, kushiriki na kuigiza mazungumzo kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya kusikiliza na kujibu mazungumzo aliyojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la usafi wa kibinafsi na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Integrated Science na Agriculture.

outcomes.text: kutambua vipengele vya kuzingatia katika usikilizaji wa mazungumzo
kutambua vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kujibu mazungumzo
kutumia vipengele vifaavyo katika kusikiliza na kujibu mazungumzo
kuchangamkia kushiriki mazungumzo katika miktadha mbalimbali

skills.name: Sikiliza na ujibu mazungumzo ipasavyo
skills.mastery: Names the features to keep in this kind of talk (mazungumzo), picks the better of two ways to listen or reply in a situation on usafi wa kibinafsi, and takes part in one in standard Kiswahili, judged by the teacher with the KICD rubric; in the app, 8 of 10 new items right.

prerequisites.reason: Grade 6 chose language to fit the setting.
Grade 6 spoke in front of others with gestures.

misconceptions.error: Replies with one word and gives nothing back, so the conversation stops.

example.question: Rafiki anakuuliza: "Unafanyaje kudumisha usafi wako?" Jibu lipi linaendeleza mazungumzo?
example.correct_answer: Ninaoga kila siku na kufua nguo zangu. Wewe je?

misconceptions.cause: The child answers questions as in a test.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Rafiki anakuuliza: "Unafanyaje kudumisha usafi wako?" Jibu lipi linaendeleza mazungumzo?" with "Sijui." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Practise answer + one detail + a question back.
misconceptions.feedback: Jibu kikamilifu na umrudishie mwenzako swali.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Interrupts the speaker before he finishes.

example.question: Mwenzako bado anazungumza na una jambo la kusema. Ufanye nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child fears losing his idea.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mwenzako bado anazungumza na una jambo la kusema. Ufanye nini?" with "mkatize ili usisahau" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Note the idea on paper; wait for the pause.
misconceptions.feedback: Msikilize mzungumzaji hadi amalize.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Listens or speaks without looking at the other person (looks down or away).

example.question: Ni ishara ipi inaonyesha unasikiliza kwa makini?

misconceptions.cause: Looking away is a sign of respect at home for some children; in class talk it reads as not listening.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni ishara ipi inaonyesha unasikiliza kwa makini?" with "kuangalia chini muda wote" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Practise in pairs: listen with eyes on the speaker and nods; then swap.
misconceptions.feedback: Mwangalie mzungumzaji ili aone unamsikiliza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Answers or speaks on something other than the topic (usafi wa kibinafsi).

example.question: Mada ni usafi wa kibinafsi. Ni mchango upi unafaa?
example.correct_answer: Tunaweza kuchangia usafi wa kibinafsi kwa njia hii...

misconceptions.cause: The child says what is on his mind.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mada ni usafi wa kibinafsi. Ni mchango upi unafaa?" with "Jana nilitazama filamu nzuri sana." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Repeat the topic before speaking; link your point to it in the first sentence.
misconceptions.feedback: Changia kuhusu mada inayojadiliwa.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Ufahamu (Theme 1: Usafi wa kibinafsi)
learning_experiences: kusoma kifungu cha simulizi kwenye kitabu au kifaa cha kidijitali,
kudondoa habari mahususi (k.v. nani, nini, wapi, lini) katika kifungu cha simulizi,
kupanga matukio yanavyofuatana katika kifungu cha simulizi,
kufanya utabiri na ufasiri kutokana na kifungu cha simulizi alichosoma,
kueleza msamiati (k.v. maneno na nahau) katika kifungu cha simulizi na kuueleza kwa kutumia kamusi,
kusoma vifungu vya simulizi mtandaoni au kwenye vitabu kuhusu suala lengwa (usafi wa kibinafsi) kisha atambue na kueleza maana za msamiati huo kulingana na muktadha wa matumizi,
kumsomea mzazi au mlezi sentensi kuhusu usafi wa kibinafsi kisha kumuelezea maana za msamiati wa suala husika kimuktadha.
key_inquiry_questions: Kwa nini tunasoma ufahamu?
Je, ni mambo gani yanayoweza kukusaidia kuelewa kifungu cha simulizi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za kudondoa habari mahususi.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapobashiri na kufasiri kutokana na kifungu cha ufahamu.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anaposakura mtandaoni na kusoma vifungu kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji katika kikundi.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki na kuchangia katika shughuli za ujifunzaji akiwa na wenzake.
sub_strands.pcis: Usafi wa kibinafsi: mwanafunzi anaposoma matini kuhusu suala lengwa na kuzingatia ujumbe.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kusoma kifungu cha simulizi na ujifunzaji wa stadi hiyo katika somo la English.

misconceptions.error: Answers a "why" question with a "what" (an event, not its reason).

example.question: Kwa nini mhusika alikimbia nyumbani?
example.correct_answer: kwa sababu aliogopa mbwa wa jirani

misconceptions.cause: The child finds the sentence with the words of the question and copies the event.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kwa nini mhusika alikimbia nyumbani?" with "alikimbia nyumbani" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Underline the question word: nini, nani, wapi, lini, kwa nini; the answer must fit it.
misconceptions.feedback: Swali la "kwa nini" hujibiwa kwa sababu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Orders the events as they are told in the question or the options, not as they happen in the passage.

example.question: Ni tukio lipi lilitokea kwanza katika kifungu?

misconceptions.cause: The order of the options is taken for the order of the story.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni tukio lipi lilitokea kwanza katika kifungu?" with "tukio lililotajwa kwanza katika swali" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Number the events in the margin of the passage before looking at the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Fuata mpangilio wa matukio katika kifungu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Predicts with no clue from the passage, from what he wishes would happen.

example.question: Kutokana na kifungu, nini kitatokea baadaye?
example.correct_answer: jibu linalotokana na vidokezo vya kifungu

misconceptions.cause: Prediction is taken as imagination.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kutokana na kifungu, nini kitatokea baadaye?" with "mhusika atakuwa tajiri sana" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Every prediction needs a clue: "kwa sababu kifungu kinasema..."
misconceptions.feedback: Utabiri hutokana na vidokezo vya kifungu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the meaning of a look-alike word, or the everyday meaning where the passage means another.

example.question: Katika kifungu, neno "kupiga" katika "alipiga simu" lina maana gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child knows one meaning and does not test it against the sentence.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Katika kifungu, neno "kupiga" katika "alipiga simu" lina maana gani?" with "kumpiga mtu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Put each meaning into the sentence; keep the one that fits.
misconceptions.feedback: Maana ya neno hutegemea sentensi lilimo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Viakifishi (Theme 1: Usafi wa kibinafsi)
learning_experiences: kutambua herufi kubwa na kikomo katika maneno, sentensi au vifungu kwenye matini andishi au za kidijitali,
kutafiti mtandaoni au kwenye vitabu vya ziada kuhusu matumizi ya herufi kubwa na kikomo katika maneno, sentensi na vifungu na kuandika daftarini mwake,
kueleza matumizi ya herufi kubwa na kikomo katika maneno, sentensi na vifungu kwenye matini andishi au za kidijitali,
kuandika maneno, sentensi au vifungu vifupi kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kutumia herufi kubwa na kikomo ipasavyo,
kuwasomea wenzake au kuwasambazia kazi yake kwenye mtandao ili waitolee maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Herufi kubwa na kikomo hutumika vipi katika maandishi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapowasomea wenzake kifungu kwa ufasaha na anaposhiriki katika mijadala na wanafunzi wenzake.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika vifungu vyenye matumizi yafaayo ya herufi kubwa na kikomo.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapotafiti mtandaoni kuhusu matumizi ya herufi kubwa na kikomo katika matini.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapotumia herufi kubwa na kikomo katika kifungu alichokiandika.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani na katika kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis: Usafi wa kibinafsi: mwanafunzi anapoandika kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kutumia herufi kubwa na kikomo ipasavyo.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya herufi kubwa na kikomo aliyojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na yale amejifunza kuhusu dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la usafi wa kibinafsi na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Integrated Science na Agriculture.

skills.name: Tumia herufi kubwa na kikomo
skills.mastery: Mtoto hutumia herufi kubwa mwanzoni mwa sentensi na kwa majina ya pekee, na kikomo (.) mwishoni mwa sentensi ya kawaida. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

Grade 6 marks.

misconceptions.reveals: Offer "tuliona nairobi jana." next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.

sub_strands.sub_strand: Aina za nomino (Theme 1: Usafi wa kibinafsi)
learning_experiences: kutambua nomino za pekee na za kawaida kwenye orodha ya maneno, sentensi au vifungu,
kutaja aina za nomino za pekee (k.v. majina ya watu, siku za wiki, miezi ya mwaka, mito, nchi, anwani za vitabu, za magazeti na za majarida),
kujaza nafasi katika sentensi au vifungu kwa kutumia nomino za pekee na za kawaida ipasavyo,
kutunga sentensi au vifungu vifupi kwa kutumia nomino za pekee na za kawaida akizingatia masuala mtambuko mbalimbali likiwemo suala la usafi wa kibinafsi,
kumtajia mzazi au mlezi wake nomino za pekee na za kawaida katika mazingira ya nyumbani.
key_inquiry_questions: Ni vitu gani katika mazingira yako ambavyo ni nomino za pekee?
Ni vitu gani katika mazingira yako ambavyo ni nomino za kawaida?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapotaja nomino za pekee na za kawaida akiwa na wenzake.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kutambua nomino za pekee na za kawaida.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi kuhusu suala lengwa akitumia nomino za pekee na za kawaida.

Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

prerequisites.reason: Grade 5 told proper from common nouns.
Grade 5 common nouns.

misconceptions.error: Writes a common noun with a capital letter.

example.question: Ni nomino ipi ni ya pekee?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.

misconceptions.help: Nomino ya pekee ni jina mahususi la mtu au mahali, kama Kisumu.

misconceptions.error: Writes a proper noun with a small letter.

misconceptions.reveals: Offer "Herufi ndogo" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi imeandikwa sawa?

misconceptions.cause: The child knows names take capitals but treats the title as a common word even when it is part of the name.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi imeandikwa sawa?" with "Tulimwona daktari Otieno jana." among the options.
misconceptions.help: A title joined to a name is part of the name: Daktari Otieno, Mwalimu Akinyi; alone it is common: daktari alikuja.

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusikiliza kwa Kina (Theme 2: Lishe bora)
learning_experiences: kutambua sauti /dh/ na /th/ katika silabi na maneno,
kutambua maneno yenye sauti /dh/ na /th/ yakitamkwa na mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa au katika kifaa cha kidijitali na kuyatamka ipasavyo,
kutumia maneno yenye sauti /dh/ na /th/ kwenye sentensi ili kuyatofautisha kimaana,
kusikiliza sentensi zilizotungwa na wenzake na kutoa maoni yake kuhusu jinsi maneno yenye sauti /dh/ na /th/ yalivyotumiwa,
kuunda vitanzandimi vinavyotumia sauti /dh/ na /th/ daftarini mwake au kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali,
kusoma vitanzandimi alivyounda akizingatia matamshi bora ya sauti /dh/ na /th/ huku wenzake wakisikiliza ili wamtolee maoni,
kumsomea mzazi au mlezi wake kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa akizingatia matamshi bora ya sauti /dh/ na /th/.
key_inquiry_questions: Ni maneno yepi unayoyajua yaliyo na sauti /dh/ na /th/?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki na kuchangia katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali katika kuunda na kusikiliza vitanzandimi vyenye sauti /dh/ na /th/.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapounda vitanzandimi vyenye maana akitumia maneno yenye sauti /dh/ na /th/ na kuvitamka ipasavyo katika kikundi.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapotamka ipasavyo sauti /dh/ na /th/ katika silabi na maneno na kuunda vitanzandimi kwa kutumia maneno yenye sauti /dh/ na /th/.

kutamka sauti /dh/ na /th/ ipasavyo katika silabi na maneno

skills.name: Tofautisha sauti /dh/ na /th/ katika silabi, maneno na vitanzandimi
skills.mastery: Hears, says and writes the right sound in syllables and words with /dh/ na /th/ (dhamini and thamini, dhibiti and thibiti), picks the word that matches the meaning, and tells a real kitanzandimi from an ordinary sentence, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Grade 6 told close sounds apart.
Grade 5 met th/dh first, with f/v, s/z and l/r.

misconceptions.error: Hears or says /th/ for /dh/, so dhamini (to sponsor or guarantee) becomes thamini (to value).

example.question: Mwalimu anasema: "dhamini". Umesikia neno lipi?

misconceptions.cause: Many Kenyan speakers say z for dh (zahabu) and s for th (sumuni) because their first languages lack these Arabic-origin sounds; the child then cannot tell dh from th either.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mwalimu anasema: "dhamini". Umesikia neno lipi?" with "thamini" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Say the pair slowly with a hand on the throat (or watching the lips); the child says which word was heard before writing.
misconceptions.feedback: Sikiliza tena: "dhamini" ina sauti /dh/. "thamini" ni neno lingine lenye maana nyingine.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes the word with the letter of the other sound (thibiti where dhibiti is meant).

example.question: Jaza pengo: ___ maana yake ni "to control".

misconceptions.cause: The child spells as he speaks; if the two sounds are one sound in his speech, the letter is a guess.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza pengo: ___ maana yake ni "to control"." with "thibiti" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Pair each spelling with its meaning on a card; the child sorts the cards by meaning, then by letter.
misconceptions.feedback: Neno lenye maana ya "to control" ni "dhibiti". "thibiti" lina maana ya "to prove".
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Thinks the two words are one word said in two ways, with one meaning.

example.question: "dhibiti" na "thibiti" ni maneno yenye maana moja?

misconceptions.cause: The child has heard both said by different people for the same thing and takes the difference for an accent.
misconceptions.reveals: The question ""dhibiti" na "thibiti" ni maneno yenye maana moja?" with "ndiyo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Use both words in two sentences that cannot swap: the child says which sentence breaks.
misconceptions.feedback: Hapana. "dhibiti" ni to control, na "thibiti" ni to prove.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes any long sentence for a kitanzandimi, though it does not repeat the target sounds.

example.question: Ni kipi ni kitanzandimi?
example.correct_answer: Dhahabu ya thamani ya Dhahiri ilithibitishwa na dhamana ya thelathini.

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks a kitanzandimi is any sentence that is hard to say, not one built by repeating close sounds.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni kipi ni kitanzandimi?" with "Mboga na matunda hujenga mwili." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Underline the target sounds in the real kitanzandimi; count them; the ordinary sentence has few or none.
misconceptions.feedback: Kitanzandimi hurudia sauti zinazokaribiana, kama /dh/ na /th/, ili kiwe kigumu kutamka.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Breaks the word into syllables at the wrong place, so the target sound is lost (dh-amini read as two wrong parts).

example.question: Neno "dhamini" lina silabi zipi?

misconceptions.cause: In Kiswahili every syllable ends in a vowel, and a nasal with its consonant (nd, mb, nj, ng) starts one syllable; the child splits by letters, not by sound.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Neno "dhamini" lina silabi zipi?" with "d-hamini" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Clap the word: one clap per vowel; the nasal goes with the consonant after it.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila silabi ya Kiswahili huishia kwa irabu: dha-mi-ni.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Mapana (Theme 2: Lishe bora)
learning_experiences: kueleza ujumbe wa matini aliyoisoma (andishi au ya kidijitali),
kurekodi ujumbe wa matini aliyoisoma katika kijitabu chake kwa marejeleo ya baadaye,
kutambua msamiati uliotumiwa katika matini ya kujichagulia,
kutumia kamusi kutafuta maana za maneno asiyoyajua,
kujenga rekodi ya msamiati aliojifunza katika kitabu,
kutunga sentensi akitumia msamiati katika matini aliyoisoma,
kusakura mtandaoni na kujichagulia matini ya ziada kisha aisome na kumweleza mzazi au mlezi wake ujumbe wa matini hiyo.
key_inquiry_questions: Unapenda kusoma matini za aina gani?
Unazingatia nini unapochagua matini ya kujisomea?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapoandika muhtasari na kuuwasilisha kwa wenzake.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapojichagulia matini ya kusoma na kutafuta maana za maneno asiyoyajua kwenye kamusi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anaposakura mtandaoni na kujichagulia matini ya kusoma.
sub_strands.values:
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kutafuta na kusoma matini aliyojichagulia. Pia anapozingatia nidhamu anaposakura mtandaoni.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutunga sentensi akitumia msamiati aliojifunza.
sub_strands.pcis: Lishe bora: mwanafunzi anapotumia ipasavyo msamiati katika matini na kuitumia kutunga sentensi kuhusu lishe bora.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha kusoma kwa mapana katika somo la Kiswahili na yale amejifunza kuhusu usomaji huo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la lishe bora na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Integrated Science na Agriculture.

outcomes.text: kueleza ujumbe wa matini aliyosoma
kutambua msamiati uliotumiwa katika matini ya kujichagulia
kutumia ipasavyo msamiati uliotumiwa katika matini aliyosoma
kujenga mazoea ya kusoma matini za miktadha mbalimbali ili kupanua mawanda ya fikra

skills.name: Chagua matini ya kusoma na ueleze ujumbe wake
skills.mastery: Chooses a text that suits his reading level and interest from its title, blurb and first page (not from the cover alone), tells the kind of text (hadithi, shairi, makala, gazeti), says its message in one sentence, and works out a new word from the sentence around it, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Grade 6 chose and read texts.
Working out a word from its sentence.

misconceptions.error: Chooses a book by its cover picture or its thickness only.

example.question: Unataka kusoma kuhusu lishe bora. Utachaguaje kitabu?
example.correct_answer: kwa kusoma anwani, maelezo ya nyuma na ukurasa wa kwanza

misconceptions.cause: Nobody has shown the child the title, the blurb and the first page as clues.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unataka kusoma kuhusu lishe bora. Utachaguaje kitabu?" with "kwa picha nzuri ya jalada" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Hold up two books; read the title and the back of each aloud; the child chooses and says which clue decided it.
misconceptions.feedback: Anwani, maelezo ya nyuma ya kitabu na ukurasa wa kwanza hukuambia kitabu kinahusu nini.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Chooses a text far above his reading level and gives up after a page.

example.question: Ukisoma ukurasa wa kwanza wa "Sahani Yenye Rangi" na hujui maneno mengi sana, ufanye nini?
example.correct_answer: chagua matini nyingine iliyo ya kiwango chako

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks a harder book is a better book, or chooses the book a friend chose.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ukisoma ukurasa wa kwanza wa "Sahani Yenye Rangi" na hujui maneno mengi sana, ufanye nini?" with "endelea tu hata kama huelewi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: The five-finger check: on one page, a finger for each unknown word; five fingers means the book is too hard for now.
misconceptions.feedback: Matini ifaayo ni ile unayoweza kuisoma na kuielewa ukiwa peke yako.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the title as the message of the text.

example.question: Ujumbe wa matini "Sahani Yenye Rangi" ni upi?
example.correct_answer: Mlo kamili wenye vyakula vya aina mbalimbali hujenga afya.

misconceptions.cause: The title is the only sentence about the whole text that the child is sure of.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ujumbe wa matini "Sahani Yenye Rangi" ni upi?" with "Sahani Yenye Rangi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask what the writer wants the reader to learn or do; the title only names the topic.
misconceptions.feedback: Anwani hutaja mada; ujumbe ni funzo au wazo kuu ambalo mwandishi anataka ulipate.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives one detail of the text as its message.

example.question: Ni ipi ni ujumbe wa matini kuhusu lishe bora?
example.correct_answer: Mlo kamili wenye vyakula vya aina mbalimbali hujenga afya.

misconceptions.cause: The detail was striking and is remembered; the child has not asked what the whole text is about.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni ipi ni ujumbe wa matini kuhusu lishe bora?" with "Mama alipika sukumawiki na ugali." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Two boxes: "ujumbe" (one) and "maelezo" (many); the child sorts sentences from the text.
misconceptions.feedback: Ujumbe unahusu matini yote; jambo moja dogo ni maelezo tu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Does not tell one kind of text from another (takes a newspaper report for a story, or a poem for a story).

example.question: Matini yenye beti na mishororo ni ya aina gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child has met most texts as "kitabu" and has not been shown the signs of each kind.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Matini yenye beti na mishororo ni ya aina gani?" with "hadithi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Lay out a story, a poem, a newspaper page and a dictionary; the child names one sign of each.
misconceptions.feedback: Shairi lina beti na mishororo; hadithi ina aya; gazeti lina habari na tarehe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Guesses a new word from how it looks, not from the sentence it is in (mlo).

example.question: Katika matini: "Mlo kamili una wanga, protini, vitamini na madini." Neno "mlo" lina maana gani?
example.correct_answer: chakula anachokula mtu kwa wakati mmoja

misconceptions.cause: The child matches the word to a word it looks like instead of reading the sentence around it.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Katika matini: "Mlo kamili una wanga, protini, vitamini na madini." Neno "mlo" lina maana gani?" with "mlango wa nyumba" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Cover the word; the child reads the sentence and says what word would fit; then compares.
misconceptions.feedback: Soma sentensi nzima: "mlo" hapa ni chakula anachokula mtu kwa wakati mmoja.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Barua ya Kirafiki ya Kutoa Mwaliko (Theme 2: Lishe bora)
learning_experiences: kueleza umuhimu wa kuandika barua ya kirafiki ya kutoa mwaliko kuhusu masuala mbalimbali,
kutambua ujumbe katika kielelezo cha barua ya kirafiki ya kutoa mwaliko,
kujadili na wenzake vipengele vya kimuundo vya barua ya kirafiki ya kutoa mwaliko,
kushiriki katika kujadili na wenzake kuhusu lugha inayofaa katika uandishi wa barua ya kirafiki ya kutoa mwaliko,
kuandika barua ya kirafiki ya kutoa mwaliko kuhusu hafla fulani akizingatia ujumbe, lugha na muundo ufaao na kuwasomea wenzake darasani ili waitathmini.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni shughuli gani zinazoweza kukufanya uandike barua ya kirafiki ya kutoa mwaliko?
Je, ni mambo gani yanayotiliwa maanani katika kuandika barua ya kirafiki ya kutoa mwaliko?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kujadili ujumbe, lugha na muundo wa barua ya kirafiki ya kutoa mwaliko na kuheshimu maoni ya wenzake. Pia anapowasomea wenzake barua aliyoandika.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika kwa mvuto barua ya kirafiki ya kutoa mwaliko kwa kuzingatia ujumbe, lugha na muundo ufaao.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapopendekeza shughuli ambazo zinaweza kumfanya aandike barua ya kirafiki ya kutoa mwaliko. Pia anapoandika barua kuhusu masuala yanayoathiri jamii na kuwashirikisha wenzake katika kupendekeza suluhu.
sub_strands.values:
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji katika kikundi.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki na kuchangia katika shughuli za kikundi.
Amani: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi kwa utulivu.
sub_strands.pcis: Lishe bora: mwanafunzi anapoandika barua ya kirafiki ya kutoa mwaliko kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha uandishi wa barua ya kirafiki katika somo la Kiswahili na yale amejifunza kuhusu uandishi huo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la lishe bora na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Integrated Science na Agriculture.

outcomes.text: kueleza umuhimu wa barua ya kirafiki ya kutoa mwaliko
kutambua ujumbe katika barua ya kirafiki ya kutoa mwaliko
kutambua vipengele vya kimuundo vya barua ya kirafiki ya kutoa mwaliko
kuandika barua ya kirafiki ya kutoa mwaliko kwa kuzingatia ujumbe, lugha na muundo ufaao
kufurahia uandishi wa barua ya kirafiki ya kutoa mwaliko ili kufanikisha mawasiliano

skills.name: Tambua muundo wa barua ya kirafiki ya mwaliko
skills.mastery: Mtoto hutambua vipengele vya barua ya kirafiki (anwani, tarehe, salamu, ujumbe, hitimisho, jina) na umuhimu wa mwaliko. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Grade 4 wrote friendly letters.

skills.name: Andika barua ya kirafiki ya kutoa mwaliko
skills.mastery: Tells barua ya kirafiki from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes a friendly letter with the address, date, greeting, asking after the friend, the news, and a friendly closing; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: The parts of an invitation letter come before writing one.
Capitals and full stops.

misconceptions.error: Puts the closing line first.

example.question: Barua ya kirafiki huanza kwa nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "jina la mwandishi" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Barua huanza kwa anwani na tarehe, huisha kwa hitimisho na jina.
misconceptions.feedback: Barua huanza kwa anwani na tarehe, huisha kwa hitimisho na jina.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Uses a formal greeting in a friendly letter.

example.question: Ni salamu ipi inafaa barua ya kirafiki?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "Mkuu wa Shule" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Barua ya kirafiki huanza kwa salamu ya kirafiki.
misconceptions.feedback: Barua ya kirafiki huanza kwa salamu ya kirafiki.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Does not know why an invitation is written.

example.question: Mwaliko huandikwa kwa nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "kumkaripia mtu" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Mwaliko humwita mtu kwenye tukio.
misconceptions.feedback: Mwaliko humwita mtu kwenye tukio.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Writes to a friend in the stiff words of an official letter (Mheshimiwa, Kuhusu:, Wako mtiifu).

example.question: Ni salamu ipi inafaa katika barua kwa rafiki?

misconceptions.cause: The child has seen official letters at school and thinks every letter is written that way.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni salamu ipi inafaa katika barua kwa rafiki?" with "Mheshimiwa Bwana," among the options.
misconceptions.help: Put a friendly and an official letter side by side; the child highlights the words that differ.
misconceptions.feedback: Barua ya kirafiki hutumia lugha ya kirafiki: Mpendwa rafiki, Wako akupendaye.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Starts with the news straight after the greeting, with no asking after the friend (maulizo ya hali).

example.question: Baada ya salamu, ni sentensi ipi inafuata katika barua ya kirafiki?
example.correct_answer: Hujambo? Natumai u buheri wa afya.

misconceptions.cause: The child goes to what he wants to say, as in a text message.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Baada ya salamu, ni sentensi ipi inafuata katika barua ya kirafiki?" with "Nataka kukueleza kuhusu safari yetu." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Order the parts on cards: anwani, tarehe, salamu, maulizo ya hali, ujumbe, hitimisho, jina.
misconceptions.feedback: Baada ya salamu, uliza hali ya rafiki yako kabla ya kueleza ujumbe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Leaves out the date or writes it in the middle of the letter.

example.question: Tarehe huandikwa wapi katika barua ya kirafiki?
example.correct_answer: chini ya anwani ya mwandishi, upande wa kulia juu

misconceptions.cause: The date is not part of what the child wants to say, so he forgets it.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Tarehe huandikwa wapi katika barua ya kirafiki?" with "mwishoni, baada ya jina" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Label a model letter; the child places a date card on a blank layout.
misconceptions.feedback: Tarehe huandikwa chini ya anwani ya mwandishi, juu upande wa kulia.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Ends with "Wako mtiifu" and a full name and title, as in an official letter.

example.question: Ni hitimisho lipi linafaa katika barua kwa rafiki?

misconceptions.cause: Again the official model is the only one the child has copied.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni hitimisho lipi linafaa katika barua kwa rafiki?" with "Wako mtiifu, Bw. Juma Hamisi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Collect three friendly closings and keep them in the exercise book.
misconceptions.feedback: Barua ya kirafiki humalizika kwa "Ni mimi rafiki yako," na jina la kwanza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes the invitation without the event details (what, when, where, time).

example.question: Ni ujumbe upi kamili wa mwaliko?
example.correct_answer: Nakualika kwenye sherehe ya kuzaliwa kwangu Jumamosi tarehe 5 saa nane mchana nyumbani kwetu Kakamega.

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks the friend already knows the details.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni ujumbe upi kamili wa mwaliko?" with "Nakualika kwenye sherehe yangu." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Check the invitation against nini, lini, saa ngapi, wapi.
misconceptions.feedback: Mwaliko hutaja tukio, tarehe, saa na mahali.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Aina za nomino (Theme 2: Lishe bora)
learning_experiences: kutambua nomino za makundi na za dhahania kwenye chati, kadi maneno, kapu maneno na matini nyingine,
kutambua nomino za makundi na za dhahania katika mazingira ya shuleni na nyumbani na kuzitungia sentensi,
kujaza nafasi katika sentensi au vifungu kwa kutumia nomino za makundi na za dhahania ifaavyo,
kutunga sentensi au kifungu kifupi kwa kutumia nomino za makundi na za dhahania akizingatia masuala mtambuko mbalimbali likiwemo suala la lishe bora,
kushirikiana na mzazi au mlezi wake kutambua nomino za makundi na za dhahania kwenye mtandao au kwenye vitabu vya ziada na kuzitungia sentensi.
key_inquiry_questions: Ni nomino gani za makundi zinazopatikana katika mazingira ya shuleni na ya nyumbani?
Ni nomino gani za dhahania zinazopatikana katika mazingira ya shuleni na ya nyumbani?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki na kuchangia kikamilifu katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi kuhusu suala lengwa akitumia nomino za makundi na za dhahania.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutambua nomino za makundi na za dhahania na kuzitungia sentensi na vifungu sahihi.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani na katika kikundi.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki na kuchangia katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis: Lishe bora: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi na vifungu kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya nomino za makundi na za dhahania katika somo la Kiswahili na yale amejifunza kuhusu dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la lishe bora na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Integrated Science na Agriculture.

outcomes.text: kutambua nomino za makundi na za dhahania katika matini
kutumia nomino za makundi na za dhahania ifaavyo katika matini
kuchangamkia kutumia nomino za makundi na za dhahania katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tambua nomino za makundi na za dhahania
skills.mastery: Mtoto hutambua nomino za makundi (kundi la viumbe au vitu, k.m. kikosi, jeshi) na za dhahania (mambo yasiyoshikika, k.m. upendo, furaha). Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Grade 5 group nouns.
Grade 5 abstract nouns.

misconceptions.error: Thinks a collective noun names one thing.

example.question: Ni nomino ipi ni ya makundi?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "mwanafunzi" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Nomino ya makundi hutaja kundi la viumbe au vitu, kama kikosi.
misconceptions.feedback: Nomino ya makundi hutaja kundi la viumbe au vitu, kama kikosi.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Thinks an abstract noun can be touched.

example.question: Ni nomino ipi ni ya dhahania?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "meza" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Nomino ya dhahania haishikiki, kama upendo.
misconceptions.feedback: Nomino ya dhahania haishikiki, kama upendo.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Mixes collective and abstract nouns.

example.question: Neno jeshi ni nomino ya aina gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "dhahania" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Jeshi ni kundi la askari, kwa hiyo ni nomino ya makundi.
misconceptions.feedback: Jeshi ni kundi la askari, kwa hiyo ni nomino ya makundi.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Agrees the verb with the members of the group, not the group noun (Jeshi la askari wamefika).

example.question: Jaza: Jeshi la askari ___ kambini.

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks of the soldiers, who are people.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: Jeshi la askari ___ kambini." with "wamefika" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Find the head noun (jeshi, LI-YA); the verb agrees with it.
misconceptions.feedback: Kitenzi hupatana na nomino ya kundi: jeshi limefika.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Tanzu za Fasihi (Theme 3: Uhuru wa wanyama)
learning_experiences: kutafiti na kueleza maana ya fasihi katika jamii,
kutambua tanzu za fasihi na kuzitofautisha,
kujadili na wenzake sifa za fasihi simulizi na fasihi andishi,
kutambua tungo za fasihi simulizi na fasihi andishi kutoka simulizi za moja kwa moja au kwenye matini za kidijitali,
kuwasilisha darasani utungo wa fasihi anaoujua (k.v. hadithi za wanyama) ili wenzake wausikilize na kumtolea maoni,
kushiriki na mzazi au mlezi wake kutafiti kuhusu tanzu za fasihi simulizi na andishi katika jamii yake.
key_inquiry_questions: Fasihi inahusika na mambo gani katika jamii?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kuchangia katika kazi ya kikundi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kujifunza sifa za fasihi simulizi na andishi.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na mzazi au mlezi kutambua tanzu za fasihi simulizi na andishi katika jamii yake.
sub_strands.values:
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake nafasi ya kujieleza.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi.
Uraia: mwanafunzi anapothamini tungo za fasihi simulizi katika jamii.
sub_strands.pcis: Uhuru wa wanyama: mwanafunzi anaposimulia tungo na kutilia maanani uhuru wa wanyama.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha tanzu za fasihi simulizi na andishi katika somo la Kiswahili na yale amejifunza kuhusu tanzu hizo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la utunzaji wa wanyama na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies na Agriculture.
Shughuli za Ujifunzaji Swali Dadisi

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya fasihi ili kuipambanua
kujadili sifa za tanzu za fasihi
kutambua aina za tungo za fasihi simulizi na fasihi andishi katika matini
kuwasilisha utungo wa fasihi anaoujua
kufurahia kushiriki katika uwasilishaji wa fasihi simulizi na fasihi andishi ili kujenga ufasaha wa lugha na fasihi

skills.name: Eleza maana ya fasihi na tanzu zake
skills.mastery: Mtoto hueleza fasihi, hutambua fasihi simulizi (kutumia mdomo) na andishi (kuandikwa), na hutambua tanzu kama hadithi, methali na ushairi. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

prerequisites.reason: A play is one genre the child already knows.
A poem recited in Grade 6 is fasihi too.

misconceptions.error: Thinks oral literature is written.

example.question: Fasihi simulizi hupitishwa kwa njia gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "kwa maandishi" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Fasihi simulizi hupitishwa kwa mdomo.
misconceptions.feedback: Fasihi simulizi hupitishwa kwa mdomo.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Thinks written literature is spoken.

example.question: Fasihi andishi hupitishwa kwa njia gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "kwa mdomo" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Fasihi andishi huandikwa.
misconceptions.feedback: Fasihi andishi huandikwa.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Names a non-literature item as a tanzu.

example.question: Ni tanzu ipi ya fasihi simulizi?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "barua rasmi" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Methali ni tanzu ya fasihi simulizi.
misconceptions.feedback: Methali ni tanzu ya fasihi simulizi.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Mixes tanzu (genres: hadithi, ushairi, semi, mazungumzo) with vipera (their kinds: hurafa, methali, vitendawili).

example.question: Methali ni utanzu au kipera?

misconceptions.cause: Both are lists of kinds of literature.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Methali ni utanzu au kipera?" with "utanzu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Draw a tree: fasihi simulizi -> tanzu -> vipera; place each word.
misconceptions.feedback: Methali ni kipera cha semi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Kina (Theme 3: Uhuru wa wanyama)
learning_experiences: kutafiti na kueleza maana ya novela,
kutafiti maktabani au mtandaoni kuhusu sifa za novela (k.v. wahusika wachache na maudhui machache),
kuwasilisha utafiti wake darasani ili wenzake wamtolee maoni,
kusoma novela iliyoteuliwa na mwalimu na kutambua sifa zake,
kumsomea mzazi au mlezi sifa za novela aliyosoma.
key_inquiry_questions: Unawezaje kutofautisha novela na tungo nyingine za fasihi andishi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapochangia katika shughuli za kikundi kwa kutumia lugha fasaha.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapofanya utafiti maktabani au mtandaoni kuhusu maana na sifa za novela. Pia anaposoma tafiti za wenzake na kuzitolea maoni.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapowawasilishia wenzake utafiti wake kuhusu sifa za novela.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika kikundi wanapojadili sifa za novela.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali ipasavyo na kuzingatia maadili anapotafiti mtandaoni.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake nafasi ya kuwasilisha maoni yao kuhusu utafiti wake wa sifa za novela.
sub_strands.pcis: anuwai kulingana na maudhui yaliyoangaziwa katika novela.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha usomaji wa novela katika somo la Kiswahili na yale amejifunza kuhusu usomaji huo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la utunzaji wa wanyama na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies na Agriculture.

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya novela ili kuipambanua
kujadili sifa za novela kama utanzu wa fasihi andishi
kuchangamkia usomaji wa novela ili kukuza stadi ya kusoma

skills.name: Eleza maana na sifa za novela
skills.mastery: Explains the utanzu of a novela read in class ("Kisima cha Matumaini") with a correct term, gives evidence from the text for every point, and says why it matters to the work, in 8 of 10 new items (longer written answers marked by the teacher).

prerequisites.reason: Fasihi andishi and its tanzu come first.
Reading a long narrative for its facts.

misconceptions.error: Takes a novela for another kind of text (hadithi fupi) or gives the features of the other kind.

example.question: Ni sifa ipi ni ya novela?
example.correct_answer: ni hadithi ndefu kuliko hadithi fupi yenye wahusika na matukio mengi

misconceptions.cause: The child has met several kinds of literature and keeps one list of features for all of them.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sifa ipi ni ya novela?" with "huwa na beti na mishororo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Lay a novela and a hadithi fupi side by side and list what only the novela has.
misconceptions.feedback: Novela ni hadithi ndefu ya kubuni yenye wahusika na matukio mengi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Calls a novela oral literature (fasihi simulizi) because it can be read aloud or acted.

example.question: Novela ni utanzu wa fasihi ipi?

misconceptions.cause: Plays are acted and poems are recited, so the child thinks of them as spoken.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Novela ni utanzu wa fasihi ipi?" with "fasihi simulizi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask: was it first composed in writing by a known author? Then it is fasihi andishi, even when performed.
misconceptions.feedback: Novela ni fasihi andishi: imeandikwa na mwandishi anayejulikana.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives one feature only (length, or rhyme) as the whole meaning of a novela.

example.question: Eleza maana ya novela.
example.correct_answer: ni hadithi ya kubuni ndefu kuliko hadithi fupi, yenye wahusika, mandhari na ploti

misconceptions.cause: The child remembers the most visible feature.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Eleza maana ya novela." with "ni kitabu kirefu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Build the definition from three parts: what kind of text, its form, its purpose.
misconceptions.feedback: Maana kamili ya novela hutaja aina yake, muundo wake na lengo lake.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes the narrator or a character for the author of the novela.

example.question: Ni nani mwandishi wa "Kisima cha Matumaini"?

misconceptions.cause: The narrator speaks as "I" and the child takes that voice for the writer.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni nani mwandishi wa "Kisima cha Matumaini"?" with "Neema" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Find the author's name on the cover; the narrator and characters are inside the story.
misconceptions.feedback: Mwandishi ni mtunzi; msimulizi na wahusika ni sehemu ya kazi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Insha za Kubuni (Theme 3: Uhuru wa wanyama)
learning_experiences: kuteua mada anayoweza kuiandikia insha ya kubuni,
kuteua ujumbe unaoafiki mada aliyoiteua,
kujadiliana na wenzake vidokezo vya mada aliyoteua,
kuandika vidokezo vyenye ujumbe unaolingana na mada,
kuandika insha ya kubuni inayozingatia vidokezo alivyoandaa,
kuwasilisha insha yake darasani au mtandaoni ili wenzake wamtolee maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Ni mambo gani unayozingatia unapoandaa vidokezo vya insha ya kubuni?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapojadiliana na wenzake kwa ufasaha vidokezo vya insha ya kubuni.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoteua mada na vidokezo mwafaka vya kuandikia insha ya kubuni.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapotafiti kuhusu mada anayoandikia insha ya kubuni kwenye makala mbalimbali.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kuteua mada mwafaka na kuiandalia vidokezo.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji katika kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi. Pia anapozingatia nidhamu anaposakura mtandaoni.
sub_strands.pcis: Elimu ya utunzaji wa wanyama: mwanafunzi anapotafiti na kuteua mada kuhusu masuala yanayohusu wanyama.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha uandishi wa insha ya kubuni katika somo la Kiswahili na uandishi huo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la utunzaji wa wanyama na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies na Agriculture.

outcomes.text: kuteua mada na ujumbe wa kuandikia insha ya kubuni
kujadili vidokezo kulingana na mada ya kuandikia insha ya kubuni
kuandika vidokezo vyenye ujumbe unaolingana na mada ya insha ya kubuni
kuandika insha ya kubuni inayozingatia vidokezo vilivyoandaliwa
kufurahia kuandaa vidokezo vyenye ujumbe unaolingana na mada ya insha

skills.name: Teua mada, andaa vidokezo na uandike insha ya kubuni
skills.mastery: Tells insha ya kubuni from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes a creative story built paragraph by paragraph, with characters, a setting and vivid language; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Grade 6 wrote masimulizi with a plan, a flow and a closing.
Capitals and full stops in a longer piece.

misconceptions.error: Plans with points (vidokezo) that do not belong to the title, or writes the insha without using the points planned.

example.question: Ni kidokezo kipi hakifai kwa insha "Simba Aliyetoroka Mbugani"?

misconceptions.cause: The child lists whatever comes to mind and does not check each point against the title.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni kidokezo kipi hakifai kwa insha "Simba Aliyetoroka Mbugani"?" with "Bei ya sukari imepanda dukani." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Write the title at the top of the plan; tick each point only if it helps to tell that story.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila kidokezo kinapaswa kusaidia kusimulia kisa cha anwani.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes the title as a full sentence with a full stop, or leaves it out.

example.question: Ni anwani ipi imeandikwa ipasavyo?

misconceptions.cause: The child treats the title as the first sentence of the insha.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni anwani ipi imeandikwa ipasavyo?" with "simba aliyetoroka mbugani." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Show where the title sits and how it is written (herufi kubwa, no kikomo, often underlined).
misconceptions.feedback: Anwani huandikwa juu katikati, bila kikomo, kwa herufi kubwa.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts the events in an order that cannot have happened (the end before the start), with no linking words.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Simba Aliyetoroka Mbugani"?
example.wrong_answer: simba alirudishwa mbugani, walinzi wa wanyama walifika, wanakijiji walitahadharishwa, simba alitoroka
example.correct_answer: simba alitoroka, wanakijiji walitahadharishwa, walinzi wa wanyama walifika, simba alirudishwa mbugani

misconceptions.cause: The child writes events as they come to mind; nobody has asked for a plan first.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Simba Aliyetoroka Mbugani"?" with "simba alirudishwa mbugani, walinzi wa wanyama walifika, wanakijiji walitahadharishwa, simba alitoroka" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Plan with three boxes (mwanzo, kati, mwisho) and linking words (kwanza, kisha, hatimaye) before writing.
misconceptions.feedback: Panga matukio yanavyofuatana, na utumie maneno kama kwanza, kisha na hatimaye.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Ends the insha abruptly ("Mwisho." or "The end") with no closing paragraph (hitimisho).

example.question: Ni ipi ni hitimisho bora la insha "Simba Aliyetoroka Mbugani"?
example.correct_answer: Tangu siku hiyo, nimejifunza mengi kuhusu jambo hili.

misconceptions.cause: Storybooks for young readers end with "Mwisho" and the child copies that.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni ipi ni hitimisho bora la insha "Simba Aliyetoroka Mbugani"?" with "Mwisho." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Show three endings; the child picks the one that closes the main idea or the lesson.
misconceptions.feedback: Hitimisho hufunga insha kwa kueleza funzo au hisia, si kwa neno "Mwisho" tu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Aina za nomino (Theme 3: Uhuru wa wanyama)
learning_experiences: kutambua nomino za wingi na za vitenzi-jina kwenye chati, kadi maneno au kapu maneno,
kutenga nomino za wingi na za vitenzi-jina katika orodha ya maneno, sentensi au vifungu kwa kuzipigia mstari au kuzikolezea wino katika matini za kidijitali,
kujaza nafasi katika sentensi au vifungu kwa kutumia nomino za wingi na za vitenzi-jina ipasavyo,
kutunga sentensi au vifungu vifupi kwa kutumia nomino za wingi na za vitenzi-jina akizingatia masuala mtambuko mbalimbali likiwemo suala la uhuru wa wanyama,
kushirikiana na mzazi au mlezi wake kutafiti (k.v. mtandaoni na vitabuni) kuhusu nomino za wingi na za vitenzi-jina na kuzitungia sentensi kisha awasomee wenzake darasani ili wamtolee maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni nomino zipi za wingi na za vitenzi-jina zinazopatikana katika mazingira yako?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapochangia katika kazi za kikundi kutambua na kutenga nomino za wingi na za vitenzi-jina.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi kuhusu suala lengwa akitumia nomino za wingi na za vitenzi-jina.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutambua nomino za wingi na za vitenzi-jina na kuzitungia sentensi na vifungu sahihi.
sub_strands.values:
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kuchangia katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis: Maslahi ya wanyama: mwanafunzi anapotunga aya na sentensi kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kutumia nomino za wingi na za vitenzi-jina.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya nomino katika somo la Kiswahili na dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la utunzaji wa wanyama na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies na Agriculture.

outcomes.text: kutambua nomino za wingi na za vitenzi-jina katika matini
kutumia nomino za wingi na za vitenzi-jina ipasavyo katika matini
kufurahia matumizi ya nomino za wingi na za vitenzi-jina katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tambua nomino za wingi na vitenzi-jina
skills.mastery: Mtoto hutambua nomino za wingi (maji, mafuta) na kitenzi-jina (kuimba, kusoma) kinachoanza kwa ku-. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Grade 5 nouns of wingi.
Grade 5 verbal nouns.

misconceptions.error: Does not know the ku- verbal noun.

example.question: Ni kitenzi-jina kipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "mwimbaji" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Kitenzi-jina huanza kwa ku-, kama kuimba.
misconceptions.feedback: Kitenzi-jina huanza kwa ku-, kama kuimba.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Treats maji as singular.

example.question: Ni nomino ipi ya wingi?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "kiti" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Maji ni nomino ya wingi; haina umoja.
misconceptions.feedback: Maji ni nomino ya wingi; haina umoja.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Calls the verbal noun a main verb only.

example.question: Neno kusoma katika "Kusoma ni muhimu" ni nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "kitenzi kikuu" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Hapa kusoma ni jina la jambo, kwa hiyo ni kitenzi-jina.
misconceptions.feedback: Hapa kusoma ni jina la jambo, kwa hiyo ni kitenzi-jina.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Gives a verbal noun the agreement of a person (Kusoma kwake anapendeza).

example.question: Jaza: Kuimba kwake ___ (kunapendeza / anapendeza).

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks of the singer, not the singing.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: Kuimba kwake ___ (kunapendeza / anapendeza)." with "anapendeza" among the options.
misconceptions.help: The verbal noun is in KU-KU: everything agreeing with it takes ku- / kw-.
misconceptions.feedback: Kitenzi-jina huchukua ku-: kuimba kwake kunapendeza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Nyimbo (Theme 4: Aina za maliasili)
learning_experiences: kueleza maana ya nyimbo za watoto na bembelezi,
kutafiti vitabuni au mtandaoni kuhusu sifa za nyimbo za watoto na bembelezi,
kuwasilisha matokeo ya utafiti wake kwa wenzake ili waweze kujadili sifa hizo,
kusikiliza nyimbo za watoto na bembelezi kutoka kwa mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa au kifaa cha kidijitali,

kushirikiana na wenzake kujadili mitindo ya uwasilishaji wa nyimbo za watoto na bembelezi (k.v. urudiaji wa sauti, maneno na vifungu vya maneno, uchezeshaji wa viungo vya mwili,) katika nyimbo walizosikiliza,
kuimba nyimbo za watoto na bembelezi kwa kuzingatia mitindo mbalimbali ya uwasilishaji,
kutunga nyimbo nyepesi za watoto na bembelezi na kuziwasilisha kwa kutumia mitindo ifaayo,
kuimba wimbo wa watoto na bembelezi akiwa na mzazi au mlezi wake na kujadili ujumbe katika nyimbo hizo.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni nyimbo gani za watoto unazozijua katika jamii yako?
Unapomwimbia mtoto bembelezi, unazingatia nini ili apate kulala?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusikiliza nyimbo mbalimbali za watoto na bembelezi.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapoimba na kuwasilisha nyimbo. Pia anapochangia ifaavyo katika shughuli za kikundi.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na mzazi au mlezi wake kuimba nyimbo za watoto na bembelezi.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji katika kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis: Haki za watoto: mwanafunzi anapotunga na kuwasilisha nyimbo zinazohusu masuala ya watoto.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya nyimbo katika somo la Kiswahili na dhana hiyo katika somo la English na Creative Arts and Sports.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la aina za maliasili na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies.
Shughuli za Ujifunzaji Swali Dadisi

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya nyimbo za watoto na bembelezi
kujadili sifa za nyimbo za watoto na bembelezi
kujadili mitindo ya uwasilishaji wa nyimbo za watoto na bembelezi
kuwasilisha nyimbo za watoto na bembelezi kwa kuzingatia uwasilishaji ufaao
kuchangamkia uwasilishaji wa nyimbo za watoto na bembelezi ili kukuza ubunifu

skills.name: Eleza maana, aina na sifa za nyimbo
skills.mastery: Explains the maana of nyimbo (bembelezi, wimbo wa watoto) with the right terms and examples, gives evidence or a reason for each point, and presents one with its formula, voice, gestures and audience part (presentation scored by the teacher), in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Knowing the kinds of literature (fasihi simulizi) comes first.
Grade 6 recited and sang a poem with its beat.

misconceptions.error: Mixes the two kinds (bembelezi and wimbo wa watoto) and their purposes.

example.question: "Lala mtoto lala, mama yuaja, lala" ni nyimbo ya aina gani?

misconceptions.cause: Both are nyimbo; the child has not fixed what each is for and when it is used.
misconceptions.reveals: The question ""Lala mtoto lala, mama yuaja, lala" ni nyimbo ya aina gani?" with "wimbo wa watoto" among the options.
misconceptions.help: List for each kind: who uses it, when, and why; sort examples.
misconceptions.feedback: "Lala mtoto lala, mama yuaja, lala" ni bembelezi: mtoto atulie na alale kwa amani.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Calls nyimbo written literature because it is found in a textbook.

example.question: Nyimbo ni utanzu wa fasihi ipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child meets it on the page in class.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Nyimbo ni utanzu wa fasihi ipi?" with "fasihi andishi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask: who first made it, and how was it passed on? By mouth, from one generation to the next.
misconceptions.feedback: Nyimbo ni fasihi simulizi: hupokezwa kwa mdomo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Places the nyimbo in the wrong occasion (a lullaby at a work party, a work song at a funeral).

example.question: Bembelezi hutumika lini?

misconceptions.cause: The occasion is not stated in the text, and the child does not link form to use.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Bembelezi hutumika lini?" with "wakati wowote" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Act out the occasion; which kind fits it?
misconceptions.feedback: Bembelezi hutumika mama anapombembeleza mtoto alale.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives a line of the text as its message instead of the lesson.

example.question: Ujumbe wa "Lala mtoto lala, mama yuaja, lala" ni upi?
example.wrong_answer: Lala mtoto lala, mama yuaja, lala
example.correct_answer: mtoto atulie na alale kwa amani.

misconceptions.cause: Copying a line feels like a safe answer.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ujumbe wa "Lala mtoto lala, mama yuaja, lala" ni upi?" with "Lala mtoto lala, mama yuaja, lala" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Close the text; say the lesson in your own words.
misconceptions.feedback: Ujumbe ni funzo kwa maneno yako mwenyewe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Ufasaha (Theme 4: Aina za maliasili)
learning_experiences: kujadiliana na wenzake vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kusoma makala kwa ufasaha,
kutazama vielelezo vya video za watu wanaosoma makala (k.v. hotuba na habari) kwa ufasaha,
kusoma kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa katika matini andishi au ya kidijitali akizingatia matamshi bora,
kusoma kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kuzingatia kasi ifaayo (maneno sahihi yasiyopungua 90 kwa dakika),
kusoma kifungu akizingatia sauti ifaayo (k.v. kiwango cha sauti na kiimbo),
kusoma kifungu kwa kuambatanisha ishara zifaazo panapofaa (k.v. ishara za uso na mikono),
kusoma mbele ya wenzake kazi yake ili wamtolee maoni,
kumsomea mzazi au mlezi makala akizingatia vipengele vya usomaji bora.
key_inquiry_questions: Unazingatia nini ili kusoma makala kwa ufasaha?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapofanikiwa kusoma makala kwa ufasaha na anapojadiliana na wenzake katika kikundi kuhusu vipengele vya kimsingi vya kusoma kwa ufasaha.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu kwa ufasaha.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotumia ishara zifaazo wakati wa kusoma kifungu.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli ya kusoma anakuza hamu ya ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi wanapojadili vipengele vya usomaji bora.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake nafasi ya kushiriki katika mjadala wakati wa shughuli ya ujifunzaji katika kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuwasomea wenzake kifungu.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anapotangamana na wenzake katika kikundi kujadili vipengele vya usomaji bora.
sub_strands.pcis: Masuala ya elimu ya mazingira: mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu kuhusu maliasili.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha kusoma kwa ufasaha katika somo la Kiswahili na usomaji huo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la aina za maliasili na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies.

outcomes.text: kusoma kifungu kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora
kusoma kifungu kwa kasi ifaayo
kusoma kifungu kwa kutumia sauti ipasavyo
kusoma kifungu kwa kuambatanisha ishara zifaazo
kuridhia kusoma makala kwa kuzingatia vipengele vinavyofanikisha mawasiliano

skills.name: Soma kifungu kwa sauti kwa matamshi bora, kasi ifaayo, sauti ifaayo na ishara
skills.mastery: Reads a short passage aloud at a speaking pace, pauses at the koma and the kikomo, raises the voice for a question and shows feeling for an exclamation, says every sound clearly (no l for r), and uses a matching gesture, judged by the teacher with the KICD rubric; in the app picks the better reading of a line in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Grade 6 read aloud fluently.
The features of fluent reading.

misconceptions.error: Reads word by word or syllable by syllable, so the sentence has no meaning when heard.

example.question: Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Misitu, mito na madini ni maliasili ya nchi yetu."?
example.wrong_answer: Misitu, ... mito ... na ... madini ... ni ... maliasili ... ya ... nchi ... yetu.
example.correct_answer: Misitu, mito na madini ni maliasili ya nchi yetu.

misconceptions.cause: The child is still decoding each word and has not yet learnt to read a phrase as one piece.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Misitu, mito na madini ni maliasili ya nchi yetu."?" with "Misitu, ... mito ... na ... madini ... ni ... maliasili ... ya ... nchi ... yetu." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Echo reading: the teacher reads a phrase, the child repeats it as one breath; then phrase-cut the passage with slashes.
misconceptions.feedback: Usomaji wa ufasaha husoma kundi la maneno kwa pamoja, kama tunavyozungumza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads as fast as possible and thinks the fastest reader is the best.

example.question: Ni kasi ipi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu darasani?
example.correct_answer: kasi ya kuzungumza, ili kila neno lisikike

misconceptions.cause: Reading races in class reward speed; the child has not been asked whether listeners understood.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni kasi ipi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu darasani?" with "haraka iwezekanavyo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Time two readings: one very fast, one at speaking pace; listeners answer one question after each.
misconceptions.feedback: Kasi ifaayo ni ile ya kuzungumza: si haraka mno, si polepole mno.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads a question and an exclamation in the same flat voice as a statement.

example.question: Sentensi "Je, tunatunzaje misitu yetu?" inasomwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida
example.correct_answer: sauti hupanda mwishoni kwa sababu ni swali

misconceptions.cause: The child looks at the words and not at the mark at the end.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Sentensi "Je, tunatunzaje misitu yetu?" inasomwa vipi?" with "kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read the same words three ways (. ? !); the child points at the mark that matches each reading.
misconceptions.feedback: Kiulizi (?) hupandisha sauti mwishoni; alama ya hisi (!) huonyesha hisia.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads on through the koma and the kikomo without a pause.

example.question: Unasoma: "Lo, mto umekauka kabisa!" Unasimama wapi kidogo?
example.wrong_answer: hapana mahali, unasoma moja kwa moja
example.correct_answer: kwenye koma na kwenye kikomo au alama ya hisi

misconceptions.cause: The marks are read as decoration; the child has not linked them to breath.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unasoma: "Lo, mto umekauka kabisa!" Unasimama wapi kidogo?" with "hapana mahali, unasoma moja kwa moja" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Clap once at a koma, twice at a kikomo while reading together.
misconceptions.feedback: Simama kidogo kwenye koma, na zaidi kwenye kikomo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Says /l/ for /r/ or /r/ for /l/ while reading (maliasili read as maliasiri).

example.question: Neno "maliasili" linatamkwa vipi?

misconceptions.cause: The first language of the child does not separate these sounds, so the reading carries the home sound.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Neno "maliasili" linatamkwa vipi?" with "maliasiri" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Make a list of the passage words with the hard sound; practise them before reading the passage.
misconceptions.feedback: Tamka "maliasili" kama lilivyoandikwa; "maliasiri" ni neno jingine au si neno.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Insha za Kubuni (Theme 4: Aina za maliasili)
learning_experiences: kutambua lugha ya kiubunifu katika vielelezo vya insha za masimulizi,
kushirikiana na wenzake kujadili umuhimu wa lugha ya kiubunifu katika vielelezo vya insha za masimulizi,
kubainisha wahusika na mandhari katika vielelezo vya insha za masimulizi kutoka kwenye maandishi au vifaa vya kidijitali,
kushirikiana na wenzake kujadili umuhimu wa wahusika na mandhari katika insha za masimulizi,
kuandika insha ya masimulizi akitumia lugha kiubunifu na kuwabainisha wahusika na mandhari akizingatia suala lengwa,
kuwasomea wenzake insha aliyoandika ili waitathmini,
kumsomea mzazi au mlezi kielelezo cha insha ya masimulizi kisha atambue matumizi ya lugha kiubunifu na ubainishaji wa wahusika na mandhari.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni mambo gani utahitaji kuzingatia ili kuandika insha nzuri ya masimulizi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapojadili kwa ufasaha umuhimu wa ubainishaji wa wahusika na mandhari katika insha za masimulizi. Pia anapowasomea wenzake insha aliyoandika ili waitathmini.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha kwa kutumia lugha kiubunifu na kubainisha wahusika na mandhari.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kuwasomea wenzake insha ya masimulizi.
sub_strands.values:
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji katika kikundi. Pia anapotathmini insha za wenzake.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kuchangia katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis: Masuala ya elimu ya mazingira: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya masimulizi kuhusu aina za maliasili kwa kuzingatia matumizi ya lugha kiubunifu, ubainishaji wa wahusika na mandhari.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha uandishi wa insha ya masimulizi katika somo la Kiswahili na uandishi huo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la aina za maliasili na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies.

kujadili umuhimu wa lugha ya kiubunifu katika insha za masimulizi
