kujadili umuhimu wa wahusika na mandhari katika insha za masimulizi
kuandika insha ya masimulizi akizingatia lugha, wahusika na mandhari ifaavyo
kufurahia kuandika insha ya masimulizi akizingatia lugha, wahusika na mandhari ifaavyo ili kukuza ubunifu

skills.name: Andika insha ya masimulizi kwa lugha ya kiubunifu, wahusika na mandhari
skills.mastery: Tells insha ya kubuni from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes a creative story built paragraph by paragraph, with characters, a setting and vivid language; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Theme 3 planned and wrote a creative story.
Grade 6 sitiari: one device of creative language.

misconceptions.error: Writes in plain, flat words with no language devices (tashbihi, sitiari, methali, nahau) to make the insha vivid.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ina lugha ya kiubunifu kwa insha "Mto Uliokauka"?
example.correct_answer: Mto Nzoia, uliokuwa ukitiririka kama nyoka mrefu wa fedha, sasa ulikuwa mchanga mtupu.

misconceptions.cause: The child has not been shown how devices from fasihi can be used in his own writing.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ina lugha ya kiubunifu kwa insha "Mto Uliokauka"?" with "Mto ulikauka." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Collect three devices from a class reader; rewrite one plain sentence with each.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia tashbihi, sitiari, methali au nahau kufanya insha iwe hai.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the characters no names, no features and no words of their own, so the reader cannot see them.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inamjenga mhusika vizuri katika insha "Mto Uliokauka"?
example.correct_answer: Mzee Juma, mwenye ndevu nyeupe na fimbo ya mpingo, alisimama mlangoni.

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks of the events, not the people in them.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inamjenga mhusika vizuri katika insha "Mto Uliokauka"?" with "Mtu mmoja alikuja." among the options.
misconceptions.help: For each character: a name, one look, one trait shown by an action.
misconceptions.feedback: Wape wahusika majina, sura na tabia zinazoonekana kwa matendo yao.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives no setting (time and place) or one that does not fit the events.

example.question: Ni mwanzo upi unaonyesha mandhari ya insha "Mto Uliokauka"?
example.correct_answer: Ilikuwa jioni ya Ijumaa katika soko la Gikomba, watu wakiwa wamesongamana.

misconceptions.cause: The child starts with the action.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni mwanzo upi unaonyesha mandhari ya insha "Mto Uliokauka"?" with "Kisa hiki kilitokea." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Answer lini? wapi? hali gani? in the first paragraph.
misconceptions.feedback: Onyesha mandhari: lini, wapi na hali gani.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts English or Sheng words in the insha (tulienda kwa party, mathe, form).

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi imeandikwa kwa Kiswahili sanifu?

misconceptions.cause: The child speaks a mixed language at home and with friends and does not notice the switch in writing.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi imeandikwa kwa Kiswahili sanifu?" with "Mathe alinipea form ya kujaza." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Underline each non-Kiswahili word; find the Kiswahili word together (mama, sherehe, fomu).
misconceptions.feedback: Insha huandikwa kwa Kiswahili sanifu, bila maneno ya Kiingereza wala Sheng.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Nyakati na Hali; (Theme 4: Aina za maliasili)
learning_experiences: kubainisha vitenzi vilivyo katika wakati uliopo, uliopita na ujao kutoka kwenye chati, mti maneno, kapu maneno au kwa kuvipigia mstari kwenye sentensi na vifungu,
kusoma kifungu na kutambua nyakati zilizotumiwa,
kubadilisha nyakati katika sentensi au vifungu kulingana na maagizo,
kujaza nafasi katika sentensi au vifungu kwa kutumia wakati uliopo, uliopita na ujao ipasavyo
kuandika sentensi au vifungu vifupi katika wakati uliopo, uliopita au ujao daftarini mwake au kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali akizingatia masuala mtambuko mbalimbali likiwemo suala la aina za maliasili,
kuwasomea wenzake au kuwasambazia kazi yake mtandaoni ili waitolee maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Kwa nini tunatumia nyakati mbalimbali katika mawasiliano?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapowatungia wenzake sentensi kwa kutumia wakati uliopo, uliopita na ujao ifaavyo. Pia anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kuchangia katika kazi za kikundi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kuandika sentensi katika wakati lengwa na kuwasambazia wenzake mtandaoni.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi na kuzibadilisha katika wakati uliopo, uliopita na ujao ipasavyo.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapochangia kutambua nyakati na kuzitungia sentensi ifaavyo.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani na katika kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi. Pia anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali anavyotumia.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kuchangia katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis: Masuala ya elimu ya mazingira: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi na vifungu mbalimbali kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya nyakati na hali katika somo la Kiswahili na dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la aina za maliasili na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies.

kuchangamkia kutumia wakati uliopo, uliopita na ujao ifaavyo ili kuboresha mawasiliano

skills.name: Tambua wakati uliopo, uliopita na ujao
skills.mastery: Mtoto hutambua kiambishi -na- (uliopo), -li- (uliopita) na -ta- (ujao), na hutumia wakati unaofaa. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

prerequisites.reason: Grade 4 used -li-, -na-, -ta-.
Grade 5 hu- and -me-.

misconceptions.error: Mixes the markers -li- and -ta-.

example.question: Katika "Juma alicheza jana", wakati ni upi?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "ujao" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Kiambishi -li- huonyesha wakati uliopita.
misconceptions.feedback: Kiambishi -li- huonyesha wakati uliopita.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Thinks -na- is past.

example.question: Katika "Mama anapika sasa", wakati ni upi?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "uliopita" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Kiambishi -na- huonyesha wakati uliopo.
misconceptions.feedback: Kiambishi -na- huonyesha wakati uliopo.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Thinks -ta- is present.

example.question: Katika "Tutasafiri kesho", wakati ni upi?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "uliopo" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Kiambishi -ta- huonyesha wakati ujao.
misconceptions.feedback: Kiambishi -ta- huonyesha wakati ujao.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Drops the kw- or ku- of a one-syllable verb in the future and past (atala, alila for atakula, alikula).

example.question: Jaza: Kesho tu___ (la) wali.

misconceptions.cause: With longer verbs the stem follows the marker directly, so the child does the same with monosyllabic verbs.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: Kesho tu___ (la) wali." with "tutala" among the options.
misconceptions.help: One-syllable verbs (la, nywa, ja, fa) keep ku- after -li- and -ta-: tutakula, alikunywa, atakuja.
misconceptions.feedback: Vitenzi vya silabi moja huhifadhi ku-: tutakula.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Mazungumzo Mahususi (Theme 5: Unyanyasaji wa kijinsia)
learning_experiences: kutambua, katika mazungumzo, kapu maneno, kadi maneno au matini mbalimbali, maamkuzi pamoja na majibu ya maamkuzi hayo (k.v. habari za asubuhi: njema/nzuri, sabalkheri: aheri) na maagano pamoja na majibu ya maagano hayo (k.v. kwaheri: ya kuonana, alamsiki: binuru) yanayotumiwa katika miktadha anuwai,
kutambua maamkuzi mwafaka kwa kuzingatia mahusiano ya kijamii na maagano mwafaka kulingana na nyakati za siku,
kusikiliza mazungumzo kuhusu suala lengwa katika kifaa cha kidijitali na kutaja maamkuzi na maagano yaliyotumiwa,
kuigiza mazungumzo kwa kuzingatia maamkuzi na maagano mwafaka,
kushiriki mazungumzo na mzazi au mlezi wake kwa kuzingatia maamkuzi na maagano mwafaka.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni maamkuzi na maagano gani yanayotumiwa katika jamii yako?
Kwa nini ni muhimu kujua maamkuzi na maagano mbalimbali?

Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapoigiza mazungumzo na wenzake kwa kuzingatia maamkuzi na maagano yafaayo.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusikiliza maamkuzi na maagano mbalimbali.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki mazungumzo na kutumia maamkuzi na maagano kwa ukakamavu.

Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika uigizaji na anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali vinavyotumiwa.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kuchangia katika shughuli za kikundi.

skills.name: Tumia maamkuzi na maagano ya nyakati na makundi mbalimbali ya kijamii
skills.mastery: Greets and takes leave to fit the time of day (alfajiri, asubuhi, mchana, jioni, usiku) and the group (elders, age-mates, religious groups with Bwana asifiwe or Salaam aleikum, the bereaved), and gives the right reply, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Grade 6 greetings for one and many and for the time.
Grade 6 titles and respect.

misconceptions.error: Answers a religious greeting with the reply of another (Salaam aleikum - Amina; Bwana asifiwe - Aleikum salaam).

example.question: Mtu akikusalimu "Asalaam aleikum", unajibu?

misconceptions.cause: The replies are learnt as a list without the greeting each belongs to.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mtu akikusalimu "Asalaam aleikum", unajibu?" with "Amina" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Pair cards: greeting with its reply; practise in pairs.
misconceptions.feedback: "Asalaam aleikum" hujibiwa "Waaleikum salaam".
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses the greeting of another part of the day (Habari za asubuhi at 7 p.m.; Usiku mwema on arrival).

example.question: Ni saa moja usiku unamtembelea jirani. Unasalimu vipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child uses the greeting he uses at school in the morning.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni saa moja usiku unamtembelea jirani. Unasalimu vipi?" with "Habari za asubuhi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Clock face game: greeting cards placed by time.
misconceptions.feedback: Salamu hufuata wakati: jioni ni "Habari za jioni".
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Greets the bereaved with a cheerful greeting (Habari njema?) instead of words of sympathy (Pole kwa msiba).

example.question: Unamtembelea rafiki aliyefiwa na babu. Unaanza kwa?

misconceptions.cause: Habari is the default greeting.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unamtembelea rafiki aliyefiwa na babu. Unaanza kwa?" with "Habari njema rafiki?" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Role-play a condolence visit.
misconceptions.feedback: Aliyefiwa hupewa pole: "Pole kwa msiba."
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses Shikamoo to an age-mate, or Mambo/Vipi to an elder.

example.question: Unamsalimu mwanafunzi mwenzako wa darasa la saba. Ni salamu ipi inafaa?

misconceptions.cause: The child knows Shikamoo is respectful and uses it everywhere, or the reverse.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unamsalimu mwanafunzi mwenzako wa darasa la saba. Ni salamu ipi inafaa?" with "Shikamoo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Sort people by age and role; match each to a greeting.
misconceptions.feedback: Shikamoo ni kwa mkubwa; mwenzako husalimiwa "Hujambo".
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Ufahamu (Theme 5: Unyanyasaji wa kijinsia)
learning_experiences: kudondoa habari mahususi (k.v. nani, nini, wapi, lini) katika kifungu cha ufahamu,
kutambua msamiati wa suala lengwa katika kifungu cha ufahamu na kuueleza kwa kutumia kamusi,
kuandika habari za kifungu cha ufahamu kwa ufupi,
kuwawasilishia wenzake kazi yake ili wamtolee maoni,
kumsomea mzazi au mlezi kifungu cha ufahamu na kisha kujibu maswali.
key_inquiry_questions: Unazingatia nini unapodondoa habari mahususi katika kifungu cha ufahamu?

Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kusoma na kudondoa habari katika kifungu.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anaposoma kwa ufasaha na kubainisha ujumbe katika kifungu na kukiandika kwa ufupi.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anaposakura na kusoma makala mbalimbali ya suala lengwa.

Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kuchangia katika shughuli za kikundi.

skills.name: Dondoa habari, eleza kwa ufupi na eleza msamiati katika kifungu cha ufahamu
skills.mastery: Mtoto hupata jibu kwenye kifungu na huchagua lile linalojibu swali lote, wala hachagui jambo dogo, kinyume au jambo lisilomo kwenye matini. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

misconceptions.feedback: Jibu lazima lijibu swali lote, si jambo moja dogo.

example.question: Ni jibu lipi linalopatana na matini?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.

sub_strands.sub_strand: Insha ya Maelekezo (Theme 5: Unyanyasaji wa kijinsia)
learning_experiences: kutafiti na kueleza maana ya insha ya maelekezo,
kutambua anwani ya insha ya maelekezo ambayo amesoma kwenye matini,
kutambua aina za insha za maelekezo kwenye maandishi au vifaa vya kidijitali,
kujadili na wenzake sifa za insha ya maelekezo kwa kuzingatia vielelezo vya insha kwenye matini za kimaandishi au za kidijitali,
kushiriki katika kikundi kuandaa mpangilio ufaao wa hatua za insha ya maelekezo,

kuandika insha ya maelekezo akizingatia vipengele vyake muhimu (k.v. anwani na mpangilio mwafaka wa hatua) huku akitumia vipengele vya lugha vinavyotumiwa kuelekeza ili kumjengea msomaji taswira kamili ya anachoelekezwa kufanya,
kuwasomea wenzake katika kikundi insha aliyoandika darasani au awasambazie kwenye vifaa vya kidijitali ili waitolee maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Ukimwelekeza rafiki yako nyumbani kwenu utatumia mpangilio gani wa hatua ili asipotee njia?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha kwa ufasaha na anapoisoma vizuri. Pia anaposhiriki na wenzake katika kujadili kuhusu insha ya maelekezo.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoteua lugha mwafaka na kufaulu kutoa maelezo bayana ya anachoelekeza.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapowasomea wenzake insha aliyoandika ili waitolee maoni.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kuwasomea wenzake insha hadharani.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji katika kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kuchangia katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis: Masuala ya kijamii: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha kuhusu suala la kijinsia.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha uandishi wa insha ya maelekezo katika somo la Kiswahili na uandishi huo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies.

kujadili sifa za insha ya maelekezo

skills.name: Tambua na andika insha ya maelekezo
skills.mastery: Tells insha ya maelekezo from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes instructions with their purpose, the materials, the steps in order as commands, and safety warnings; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Grade 6 wrote maelezo in order with detail.
Telling kinds of insha apart.

misconceptions.error: Starts the steps without saying what is needed (vifaa) or what the instructions are for.

example.question: Maelekezo ya "Jinsi ya Kuripoti Unyanyasaji" huanza na nini?
example.wrong_answer: hatua ya kwanza moja kwa moja
example.correct_answer: lengo la maelekezo na vifaa vinavyohitajika

misconceptions.cause: The child goes straight to doing.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Maelekezo ya "Jinsi ya Kuripoti Unyanyasaji" huanza na nini?" with "hatua ya kwanza moja kwa moja" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Plan: lengo, vifaa, hatua, tahadhari.
misconceptions.feedback: Anza kwa lengo na vifaa vinavyohitajika.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Tells what he did in the past (Nilichukua..., nilikoroga...) instead of giving instructions (Chukua..., koroga...).

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya maelekezo?

misconceptions.cause: The child turns instructions into a story of his own day.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya maelekezo?" with "Nilichukua sufuria nikaweka maji." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Underline the verbs; change each to the command or -e form (chukua, weka; uchukue).
misconceptions.feedback: Maelekezo hutumia amri au hali ya kuagiza: chukua, weka.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the steps in an order that cannot work, with no signal words.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi unafaa katika "Jinsi ya Kuripoti Unyanyasaji"?
example.wrong_answer: fuatilia hadi usaidiwe, nenda kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu, piga simu 116, mwambie mtu mzima unayemwamini
example.correct_answer: mwambie mtu mzima unayemwamini, piga simu 116, nenda kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu, fuatilia hadi usaidiwe

misconceptions.cause: The child lists steps as he remembers them.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi unafaa katika "Jinsi ya Kuripoti Unyanyasaji"?" with "fuatilia hadi usaidiwe, nenda kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu, piga simu 116, mwambie mtu mzima unayemwamini" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Act out the steps; number them; add kwanza, kisha, baadaye, mwishowe.
misconceptions.feedback: Fuata mpangilio wa hatua na utumie maneno ya mpangilio.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Leaves out safety warnings where the task needs them.

example.question: Ni kipi kinakosekana katika maelekezo ya "Jinsi ya Kuripoti Unyanyasaji"?

misconceptions.cause: Warnings are not part of the steps, so they are forgotten.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni kipi kinakosekana katika maelekezo ya "Jinsi ya Kuripoti Unyanyasaji"?" with "anwani" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask at each step: what could go wrong? Write a tahadhari.
misconceptions.feedback: Ongeza tahadhari pale panapohitajika.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Nyakati na Hali (Theme 5: Unyanyasaji wa kijinsia)
learning_experiences: kubainisha vitenzi vilivyo katika wakati uliopita hali ya kuendelea na ujao hali ya kuendelea kutoka kwenye chati, mti maneno, kapu maneno au kwa kuvipigia mstari kwenye sentensi na vifungu,
kusoma kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa na kutambua nyakati na hali zilizotumiwa,
kutunga sentensi au vifungu vifupi kwa kutumia wakati uliopita hali ya kuendelea na ujao hali ya kuendelea ifaavyo akizingatia masuala mtambuko mbalimbali likiwemo suala la unyanyasaji wa kijinsia,

kuandika sentensi kuhusu suala lengwa katika wakati uliopita hali ya kuendelea na ujao hali ya kuendelea kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali na kuwasambazia wenzake mtandaoni ili waziweke katika nyakati na hali zinazozingatiwa,
kubadilisha nyakati na hali katika kifungu kulingana na maagizo.
key_inquiry_questions: Kwa nini tunazingatia nyakati na hali mbalimbali katika mawasiliano?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kuchangia katika kazi za kikundi.

Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapobadilisha nyakati na hali mbalimbali na kutunga sentensi.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapochangia kutambua nyakati na hali na kuzitungia sentensi.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapobadilisha nyakati na hali katika kifungu.

Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani na katika kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kuchangia katika shughuli za kikundi.

skills.name: Tambua uliopita hali ya kuendelea na ujao hali ya kuendelea
skills.mastery: Mtoto hutambua alikuwa akisoma (uliopita hali ya kuendelea) na atakuwa akisoma (ujao hali ya kuendelea). Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Aspect was first met with hu- and -me-.

misconceptions.error: Uses the past continuous for a future event.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi iko katika ujao hali ya kuendelea?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "Alikuwa akisoma jana" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Ujao hali ya kuendelea hutumia atakuwa akisoma.
misconceptions.feedback: Ujao hali ya kuendelea hutumia atakuwa akisoma.

misconceptions.error: Thinks alikuwa means a finished act.

misconceptions.feedback: Alikuwa akipika ni uliopita hali ya kuendelea: tendo lilikuwa likiendelea.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ni uliopita hali ya kuendelea?

misconceptions.reveals: Offer "Alisoma jana" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Walikuwa wakicheza ni uliopita hali ya kuendelea.
misconceptions.feedback: Walikuwa wakicheza ni uliopita hali ya kuendelea.

misconceptions.error: Builds the continuous with the wrong form of the second verb (alikuwa anasoma is accepted; the child writes alikuwa alisoma or atakuwa atasoma).

example.question: Jaza: Jana saa nne mimi ni___kuwa ni___soma.

misconceptions.cause: The child puts the time marker in both verbs.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: Jana saa nne mimi ni___kuwa ni___soma." with "nilikuwa nilisoma" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Only kuwa carries the time (-li-, -ta-); the main verb takes -ki- or -na-.
misconceptions.feedback: Wakati hukaa kwenye "kuwa": nilikuwa nikisoma.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusikiliza kwa Kufasiri (Theme 6: Usalama shuleni)
learning_experiences: kusikiliza matini kuhusu suala lengwa kutoka kwa mwalimu au kifaa cha kidijitali,
kufasiri habari katika matini aliyosikiliza,
kueleza maana ya msamiati wa suala lengwa kama ulivyotumika katika habari aliyosikiliza,
kutabiri kitakachotokea katika matini kwa kurejelea vidokezo (k.v. picha, kichwa/anwani na toni ya mzungumzaji) vilivyopo katika matini,
kushirikiana na mzazi au mlezi kusikiliza na kuchanganua habari katika matini za aina mbalimbali kuhusu suala lengwa.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni mambo gani utakayozingatia katika kuchanganua habari uliyosikiliza?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapoeleza kwa ufasaha masuala yanayozungumziwa katika matini aliyosikiliza.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia ipasavyo vifaa vya kidijitali kama vile simu, redio, kipakatalishi au runinga kusikiliza matini.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapotabiri kitakachotokea katika matini aliyosikiliza.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi na kutunza vifaa vya kidijitali anavyotumia.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wengine katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis: Suala la usalama: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki na wenzake katika kikundi kuchanganua habari kwenye matini aliyosikiliza kuhusu usalama shuleni.

skills.name: Eleza masuala na msamiati katika matini ya kusikiliza

Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

Finding issues in a read passage.

kutambua maudhui mbalimbali katika novela iliyoteuliwa na mwalimu,
kujadili maudhui ya novela iliyoteuliwa na mwalimu,
kuwawasilishia wenzake darasani uchambuzi wake kuhusu maudhui ili waitolee maoni,
kuandika maelezo mafupi kuhusu maudhui katika novela aliyosoma,
kushirikiana na mzazi au mlezi kusoma chapisho la novela au kutoka mtandaoni na kutambua ujumbe wake,
kueleza maana ya dhamira katika fasihi,
kutambua dhamira ya novela iliyoteuliwa na mwalimu,
kuandika maelezo mafupi kuhusu dhamira ya novela iliyoteuliwa na mwalimu,
kuwawasilishia wenzake darasani uchambuzi wake kuhusu dhamira,
kumsomea mzazi au mlezi novela iliyochapishwa au kutoka mtandaoni na kutambua dhamira yake.

sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji kuhusu maudhui na dhamira kwenye novela akiwa na wenzake.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapowawasilishia wenzake ufupisho wa maudhui na dhamira ili waujadili na kutoa maoni.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapochambua maudhui na dhamira katika novela na kushirikiana na mzazi au mlezi katika uchambuzi.

skills.name: Jadili maudhui na dhamira katika novela
skills.mastery: Explains the maudhui of a novela read in class ("Kisima cha Matumaini") with a correct term, gives evidence from the text for every point, and says why it matters to the work, in 8 of 10 new items (longer written answers marked by the teacher).

prerequisites.reason: Knowing what a novela is comes before its themes.
Summarising is needed for the summary of themes (d).

misconceptions.error: Swaps maudhui (the issues the work is about) and dhamira (what the author aims to teach).

example.question: Katika "Kisima cha Matumaini", "kuonya jamii dhidi ya ufisadi na kuhimiza ujasiri" ni maudhui au dhamira?

misconceptions.cause: The two words are taught together and both answer "what is it about?"
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Katika "Kisima cha Matumaini", "kuonya jamii dhidi ya ufisadi na kuhimiza ujasiri" ni maudhui au dhamira?" with "maudhui" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Maudhui: the issues raised (ufisadi, elimu). Dhamira: the author's aim (kuonya, kuhimiza). Sort sentences into the two.
misconceptions.feedback: Maudhui ni masuala yanayoshughulikiwa; dhamira ni lengo la mwandishi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the title or the setting of the work as its maudhui.

example.question: Ni ipi ni maudhui katika "Kisima cha Matumaini"?

misconceptions.cause: The title is the only phrase about the whole work the child is sure of.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni ipi ni maudhui katika "Kisima cha Matumaini"?" with "Kisima cha Matumaini" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask what issue the characters face and argue about; that is the maudhui.
misconceptions.feedback: Anwani hutaja kazi; maudhui ni masuala yanayoshughulikiwa ndani yake.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives one event of the story as its maudhui.

example.question: Maudhui ya "Kisima cha Matumaini" ni yapi?

misconceptions.cause: The event is memorable; the child has not moved from what happened to what it is about.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Maudhui ya "Kisima cha Matumaini" ni yapi?" with "Neema anagundua kisima kimefungwa" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask: this event shows which issue? Write the issue in one or two words.
misconceptions.feedback: Tukio huonyesha maudhui; si maudhui lenyewe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: States a lesson from his own life or religion that the work does not raise.

example.question: Kwa mujibu wa "Kisima cha Matumaini", mwandishi analenga nini?
example.wrong_answer: kutuhimiza tuende kanisani au msikitini kila wiki
example.correct_answer: kuonya jamii dhidi ya ufisadi na kuhimiza ujasiri

misconceptions.cause: The question sounds like a moral question and the child gives a moral he knows.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kwa mujibu wa "Kisima cha Matumaini", mwandishi analenga nini?" with "kutuhimiza tuende kanisani au msikitini kila wiki" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask for the part of the text that shows the aim.
misconceptions.feedback: Dhamira lazima itokane na kazi yenyewe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Insha za Kubuni (Theme 6: Usalama shuleni)
learning_experiences: kusimuliana matukio kutokana na picha kwenye matini kuhusu suala lengwa,
kubuni anwani inayooana na kisa atakachosimulia kutokana na picha kwenye matini,
kutoa maelezo dhahiri kuhusu matukio katika picha kwenye matini,
kuandika kisa chenye maelezo dhahiri kutokana na picha kwenye matini,
kuwasomea wenzake kisa alichoandika ili wakitolee maoni,
kushirikiana na mzazi au mlezi wake kutafiti mtandaoni au vitabuni kuhusu insha za picha kisha wasimuliane visa kutokana na picha.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni vigezo vipi utakavyozingatia wakati wa kuandika insha ya kubuni kutokana na picha?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kujadiliana kuhusu matukio kwenye picha na kutoa maelezo dhahiri kutokana na picha hizo.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kutafiti kuhusu insha za picha mtandaoni.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika kisa chenye maelezo dhahiri kutokana na picha.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapotafuta habari mtandaoni au vitabuni na mzazi au mlezi wake.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji katika kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kuchangia katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis: Masuala ya usalama: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha kuhusu usalama shuleni.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha uandishi wa insha ya picha katika somo la Kiswahili na uandishi huo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la usalama na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Creative Arts and Sports, Integrated Science na Agriculture.

kuandika kisa chenye maelezo dhahiri kutokana na picha katika matini

skills.name: Andika kisa chenye maelezo dhahiri kutokana na picha
skills.mastery: Tells insha ya kubuni from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes a creative story built paragraph by paragraph, with characters, a setting and vivid language; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Vivid language, characters and setting from Theme 4.
Grade 6 wrote masimulizi with a plan, a flow and a closing.

misconceptions.error: Writes a story or a title that does not come from the picture given.

example.question: Picha inaonyesha moto katika maabara ya shule. Ni anwani ipi inafaa?

misconceptions.cause: The child writes the story he had in mind before looking.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Picha inaonyesha moto katika maabara ya shule. Ni anwani ipi inafaa?" with "Siku ya Kuzaliwa Kwangu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: List five things seen in the picture; the title and the events must use them.
misconceptions.feedback: Anwani na kisa vitokane na picha uliyopewa.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives no setting (time and place) or one that does not fit the events.

example.question: Ni mwanzo upi unaonyesha mandhari ya insha "Moto Katika Maabara ya Shule"?
example.correct_answer: Ilikuwa jioni ya Ijumaa katika soko la Gikomba, watu wakiwa wamesongamana.

misconceptions.cause: The child starts with the action.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni mwanzo upi unaonyesha mandhari ya insha "Moto Katika Maabara ya Shule"?" with "Kisa hiki kilitokea." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Answer lini? wapi? hali gani? in the first paragraph.
misconceptions.feedback: Onyesha mandhari: lini, wapi na hali gani.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Describes with empty words (kizuri sana, kibaya) and no detail that makes a picture.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Moto Katika Maabara ya Shule"?
example.correct_answer: Moshi mzito mweusi ulifuka kutoka dirisha la maabara huku wanafunzi wakikimbia nje.

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the thing well and assumes the reader sees it too.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Moto Katika Maabara ya Shule"?" with "Kulikuwa na moto." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Five senses chart: what do you see, hear, smell, touch, taste? Turn one row into a sentence.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia vivumishi na maelezo ya rangi, umbo, ukubwa na sauti ili msomaji aone picha.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts the events in an order that cannot have happened (the end before the start), with no linking words.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Moto Katika Maabara ya Shule"?
example.wrong_answer: wazima moto walifika, wanafunzi walitoka kwa mpangilio, kengele ililia, moto ulianza maabarani
example.correct_answer: moto ulianza maabarani, kengele ililia, wanafunzi walitoka kwa mpangilio, wazima moto walifika

misconceptions.cause: The child writes events as they come to mind; nobody has asked for a plan first.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Moto Katika Maabara ya Shule"?" with "wazima moto walifika, wanafunzi walitoka kwa mpangilio, kengele ililia, moto ulianza maabarani" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Plan with three boxes (mwanzo, kati, mwisho) and linking words (kwanza, kisha, hatimaye) before writing.
misconceptions.feedback: Panga matukio yanavyofuatana, na utumie maneno kama kwanza, kisha na hatimaye.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Vitenzi (Theme 6: Usalama shuleni)
learning_experiences: kutambua vitenzi vikuu (k.v. alikuwa anacheka, angali anasoma) na visaidizi (k.v. kuwa, weza, kuja, -ngali, bidi na wahi) kwenye chati, kadi maneno, kapu maneno au tarakilishi,
kubainisha vitenzi vikuu na visaidizi katika sentensi au vifungu kwenye vitabu, tarakilishi au chati kwa kuvikolezea wino au kuvipigia mstari,
kutunga sentensi akitumia vitenzi vikuu na visaidizi ipasavyo kwa kuzingatia masuala mtambuko anuwai likiwemo suala la usalama shuleni,
kutunga sentensi zinazohusu shughuli katika mazingira ya nyumbani kwa kutumia vitenzi vikuu na visaidizi (k.v. Mtoto huyu huwa anajali usalama wake).
key_inquiry_questions: Tunatofautisha vitenzi vikuu na vitenzi visaidizi kwa njia gani?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapochangia kazi za kikundi huku akiwapa wenzake nafasi ya kushiriki na kutoa maoni yao.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali katika kutambua vitenzi vikuu na visaidizi.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi akitumia vitenzi vikuu na visaidizi.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapochangia kutambua vitenzi vikuu na visaidizi na kuvitungia sentensi na vifungu sahihi.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na mzazi au mlezi wake kutunga sentensi zenye vitenzi vikuu na visaidizi vinavyohusu shughuli katika mazingira ya nyumbani.

skills.name: Tambua vitenzi vikuu na visaidizi
skills.mastery: Mtoto hutambua kitenzi kikuu (hubeba tendo) na kisaidizi (hutangulia kikuu na kusaidia, k.m. alikuwa, atakuwa). Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Grade 4 verbs.

misconceptions.error: Calls the helping verb the main verb.

example.question: Katika "Alikuwa akisoma", kitenzi kikuu ni kipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "alikuwa" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Kitenzi kikuu hubeba tendo: akisoma.
misconceptions.feedback: Kitenzi kikuu hubeba tendo: akisoma.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Calls the main verb the helping verb.

example.question: Katika "Atakuwa akifanya kazi", kitenzi kisaidizi ni kipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "akifanya" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Kitenzi kisaidizi hutangulia kikuu: atakuwa.

example.question: Katika "Walikuwa wakicheza", kuna vitenzi vingapi?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "kimoja" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Sentensi hii ina kisaidizi na kikuu.
misconceptions.feedback: Sentensi hii ina kisaidizi na kikuu.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Thinks "kuwa" is always a helping verb, even where it is the only verb (Alikuwa mgonjwa).

example.question: Katika "Alikuwa mgonjwa", "alikuwa" ni kitenzi gani?

misconceptions.cause: Kuwa is taught first as a helping verb.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Katika "Alikuwa mgonjwa", "alikuwa" ni kitenzi gani?" with "kisaidizi" among the options.

misconceptions.feedback: Kuwa ni kisaidizi tu kinapotangulia kitenzi kingine.

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusikiliza kwa Ufahamu (Theme 7: Kuhudumia jamii shuleni)
learning_experiences: kutambua ujumbe wa suala lengwa uliotumiwa katika ufahamu wa kusikiliza kutoka kwa mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa au kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali,
kueleza maana za msamiati wa suala lengwa kama ulivyotumiwa katika kauli au sentensi zilizosemwa,
kusikiliza kauli au vifungu vya sentensi kuhusu suala lengwa kutoka kwa mwalimu au mgeni mwalikwa na kufasiri ujumbe katika kauli au sentensi hizo,
kushirikiana na mzazi au mlezi kusikiliza ufahamu kuhusu suala lengwa kutoka kwa kifaa cha kidijitali na kutambua maana ya msamiati na ujumbe muhimu.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, kusikiliza kwa ufahamu kuna faida zipi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kujadili kuhusu vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kusikiliza kwa ufahamu.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusikiliza kauli na sentensi na kujibu.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anaposikiliza na kusema upya alichoambiwa. Pia anapofasiri wazo kuu.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapofasiri ujumbe kutokana na ufahamu wa kusikiliza.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi. Pia anapoheshimu zamu ya wenzake katika mazungumzo.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowasikiliza wasemaji kwa makini. Pia anapowapa wanafunzi wenzake zamu ya kuzungumza.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali anavyotumia katika mazungumzo.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli ya kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis: Mshikamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli ya ujifunzaji wa kusikiliza kwa ufahamu kuhusu kuhudumia jamii shuleni.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya kusikiliza kwa ufahamu katika somo la Kiswahili na dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la huduma katika jamii shuleni na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies.

sub_strands.sub_strand: Ufupisho (Theme 7: Kuhudumia jamii shuleni)
learning_experiences: kueleza maana ya ufupisho,
kusoma kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa katika matini andishi au ya kidijitali,
kutambua kwenye matini andishi au ya kidijitali habari kuu za aya na kuzieleza kwa usahihi kwa kuzingatia mtazamo wa matini katika matini ya kufupishwa,
kufupisha kifungu alichosoma kwa kuzingatia mpangilio ufaao wa habari sahihi kutokana na matini,
kuwawasilishia wenzake kazi yake ili waitolee maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Unazingatia nini unapofupisha kifungu?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapojadiliana na wenzake katika kikundi habari kuu za aya kwenye kifungu alichosoma.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapoandaa ufupisho na kuwawasilishia wenzake ili waitolee maoni.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika ufupisho kwa kuzingatia mpangilio ufaao.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu mtandaoni na kudondoa hoja muhimu.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi wanapojadili hoja na maneno muhimu.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji katika kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi. Pia, anapojitolea kuiandaa kazi yake ili kuwawasilishia wenzake.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anapotangamana na wenzake katika kikundi kujadili maneno na hoja muhimu katika kifungu.
sub_strands.pcis: Uongozi na utawala mwema: mwanafunzi anapofupisha kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya ufupisho katika somo la Kiswahili na dhana hiyo katika somo la English.

sub_strands.sub_strand: Insha za Kubuni (Theme 7: Kuhudumia jamii shuleni)
learning_experiences: kutambua msamiati ufaao katika kutoa maelezo (k.v. vivumishi na vielezi) kutoka kwa vielelezo vya insha kwenye matini za kimaandishi au za kidijitali,
kutumia kifaa cha kidijitali kupigia mstari maneno yaliyotumiwa kutoa maelezo katika kifungu,
kutambua umuhimu wa kuteua maneno yafaayo katika kielelezo cha insha ya maelezo,
kuandika insha ya maelezo kwa kuzingatia msamiati ufaao ili kujenga maelezo dhahiri yenye kuathiri hisia mbalimbali na kutekeleza majukumu ya kushawishi, kuburudisha, kupasha habari au kufunza,
kuwasomea wenzake insha aliyoandika ili waitolee maoni.

Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kusahihisha insha.

Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kuandika insha inayosawiri picha halisi ya kitu anachoelezea.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapowasomea wenzake insha aliyoandika ili waikosoe pamoja.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani na katika kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis: Haki na majukumu ya kibinadamu: mwanafunzi atakapoandika insha ya maelezo akizingatia suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha uandishi wa insha ya maelezo katika somo la Kiswahili na uandishi huo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la huduma katika jamii shuleni na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies.

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya insha ya maelezo
kutambua msamiati ufaao katika kutoa maelezo
kutambua umuhimu wa msamiati ufaao katika insha ya maelezo
kutumia msamiati ufaao kwa ufasaha katika kuandika insha ya maelezo
kufurahia kuandika insha za maelezo ili kujenga stadi ya kuandika

skills.name: Tumia msamiati ufaao katika insha ya maelezo
skills.mastery: Tells insha ya maelezo from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes a description or explanation with exact vocabulary, ordered paragraphs and vivid language; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Grade 6 wrote maelezo in order with detail.
Grade 6 wrote a description with exact detail.

misconceptions.error: Uses vague or repeated words (kitu, kizuri, sana sana) where an exact word is needed.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ina msamiati ufaao kuhusu "Siku ya Huduma kwa Jamii Shuleni"?
example.correct_answer: Tulipanda miche mia moja ya mikaratusi kando ya uzio wa shule.

misconceptions.cause: The child writes as he talks and has a small store of exact words.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ina msamiati ufaao kuhusu "Siku ya Huduma kwa Jamii Shuleni"?" with "Tulifanya vitu vingi vizuri." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Keep a theme word bank; replace every "kitu" and "kizuri" from it.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia neno mahususi badala ya maneno ya jumla.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Describes with empty words (kizuri sana, kibaya) and no detail that makes a picture.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Siku ya Huduma kwa Jamii Shuleni"?
example.correct_answer: Tulipanda miche mia moja ya mikaratusi kando ya uzio wa shule.

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the thing well and assumes the reader sees it too.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Siku ya Huduma kwa Jamii Shuleni"?" with "Tulifanya vitu vingi vizuri." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Five senses chart: what do you see, hear, smell, touch, taste? Turn one row into a sentence.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia vivumishi na maelezo ya rangi, umbo, ukubwa na sauti ili msomaji aone picha.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Tells a story of what happened where the insha should explain or describe.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya maelezo kuhusu "Siku ya Huduma kwa Jamii Shuleni"?
example.correct_answer: Tulipanda miche mia moja ya mikaratusi kando ya uzio wa shule.

misconceptions.cause: Stories are the kind of writing the child has done most and he falls back on it.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya maelezo kuhusu "Siku ya Huduma kwa Jamii Shuleni"?" with "Siku moja tulienda sokoni tukapotea." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask what the reader should know about the topic at the end: what it is, how it works or is done.
misconceptions.feedback: Insha ya maelezo hueleza jambo lilivyo au jinsi linavyofanywa, si matukio ya siku moja.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts in points that are not about the title.

example.question: Katika insha ya maelezo yenye anwani "Siku ya Huduma kwa Jamii Shuleni", ni sentensi ipi haifai?
example.wrong_answer: Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu.
example.correct_answer: Tulipanda miche mia moja ya mikaratusi kando ya uzio wa shule.

misconceptions.cause: The child adds whatever he remembers so the insha is long enough.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Katika insha ya maelezo yenye anwani "Siku ya Huduma kwa Jamii Shuleni", ni sentensi ipi haifai?" with "Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read each sentence and ask: does it tell the reader about the title? Cross out the ones that do not.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila sentensi ya insha inapaswa kuhusu anwani.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Vitenzi Vishirikishi (Theme 7: Kuhudumia jamii shuleni)
learning_experiences: kujadili na mwenzake maana ya vitenzi vishirikishi,
kuchopoa vitenzi vishirikishi (k.v. ni, si, yu, ndiye, ndio, ndipo) kwenye chati, kadi maneno, kapu maneno au tarakilishi,
kutaja vitenzi vishirikishi vinavyojitokeza katika sentensi na vifungu,
kutenga vitenzi vishirikishi katika orodha ya maneno, sentensi au vifungu kwenye vitabu, tarakilishi kwa kuvikolezea wino au kuvipigia mstari,
kutunga sentensi na vifungu kwa kutumia vitenzi vishirikishi akizingatia masuala mtambuko mbalimbali likiwemo suala la kuhudumia jamii shuleni,
kutunga sentensi zenye vitenzi vishirikishi zinazohusu shughuli katika mazingira ya nyumbani na kumsomea mzazi au mlezi wake (k.v. mimi ni mwanafunzi mtiifu).
key_inquiry_questions: Je, unajua aina gani za vitenzi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapotaja kwa uwazi vitenzi vishirikishi vinavyojitokeza katika sentensi na vifungu. Pia anapojadiliana na mwenzake kuhusu maana ya kitenzi kishirikishi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali katika kutambua vitenzi vishirikishi.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi kuhusu suala lengwa akitumia vitenzi vishirikishi.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki kutambua vitenzi vishirikishi na kuvitungia sentensi sahihi na vifungu kwa ukakamavu.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani na katika kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis: Masuala ya huduma kwa jamii: mwanafunzi anapoandika sentensi na vifungu kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kutumia vitenzi vishirikishi.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya vitenzi vishirikishi katika somo la Kiswahili na dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la huduma katika jamii shuleni na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua vitenzi vishirikishi katika matini
kutumia vitenzi vishirikishi katika matini
kuonea fahari matumizi ya vitenzi vishirikishi katika sentensi na vifungu

skills.name: Tambua na utumie vitenzi vishirikishi
skills.mastery: Mtoto hutambua kitenzi kishirikishi (ni, si, yuko, wako, ndiye, ndio) na hukitumia sentensi. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Yuko, kuko, mko take the -ko of place, met with PA-KU-MU.

misconceptions.error: Mixes ni and si.

example.question: Ni kitenzi kishirikishi kipi cha kukanusha?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "ni" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Si ni kishirikishi cha kukanusha; ni cha kuthibitisha.
misconceptions.feedback: Si ni kishirikishi cha kukanusha; ni cha kuthibitisha.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Uses yuko for a plural subject.

example.question: Kamilisha: Wanafunzi ___ darasani.

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "yuko" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Wanafunzi ni wengi, kwa hiyo tunasema wako.
misconceptions.feedback: Wanafunzi ni wengi, kwa hiyo tunasema wako.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Does not know that si- is negative.

example.question: Neno sio katika "Huyu sio mwalimu" linaonyesha nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "kuthibitisha" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Sio ni kishirikishi cha kukanusha.
misconceptions.feedback: Sio ni kishirikishi cha kukanusha.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Uses ndiye for things or ndio for one person (Kitabu ndiye changu).

example.question: Jaza: Kitabu hiki ___ changu.

misconceptions.cause: Ndiye is the first form learnt and is used for everything.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: Kitabu hiki ___ changu." with "ndiye" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ndi- + the class pronoun: ndiye (mtu), ndicho (kitu), ndio (miti, nk.).
misconceptions.feedback: Kishirikishi ndi- hupatana na nomino: kitabu ndicho.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kuzungumza ili Kupasha Habari (Theme 8: Ulaguzi wa binadamu)
learning_experiences: kueleza maana ya kuzungumza ili kupasha habari,
kujadili na wenzake aina za uzungumzaji wa kupasha habari katika jamii yake,
kusikiliza aina mbalimbali za uzungumzaji kutoka kwa mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa, wanafunzi wenzake au vifaa vya kidijitali,
kutambua uzungumzaji wa kupasha habari kutoka kwenye aina za uzungumzaji alizosikiliza,
kujadili vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kuzungumza ili kupasha habari,
kusikiliza uzungumzaji wa kupasha habari ukitolewa na mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa au katika vifaa vya kidijitali na kutathmini kama umetumia vipengele vifaavyo vya kuzungumza ili kupasha habari,
kushiriki katika uzungumzaji wa kupasha habari kuhusu suala lengwa akitumia vipengele vifaavyo vya mazungumzo ya kupasha habari,
kushiriki katika mazungumzo na mzazi au mlezi wake kuhusu suala lengwa huku akitumia vipengele vifaavyo vya kupasha habari.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, uzungumzaji wa kupasha habari hutolewa katika miktadha gani ya jamii yako?
Je, utatumia mikakati gani ili kuwapasha wanajamii habari kuhusu mambo mbalimbali?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kikundi kujadili aina za uzungumzaji wa kupasha habari katika jamii yake. Pia anapowaeleza wenzake kuhusu vipengele vya kuzingatia ili kufanikisha mawasiliano.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika uzungumzaji ili kupasha habari kuhusu suala lengwa.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki na mzazi au mlezi wake katika uzungumzaji ili kupasha habari kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapoihusisha hadhira yake katika uzungumzaji. Pia anapowapa wenzake zamu ya kushiriki katika mazungumzo kuhusu suala lengwa.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali anavyotumia katika kujifunza uzungumzaji ili kupasha habari.
Amani: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi kwa utulivu.
sub_strands.pcis:
Masuala ya usalama: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kupasha habari kuhusu suala la ulanguzi wa binadamu.
Ulanguzi wa binadamu: mwanafunzi anapowapasha wenzake habari kuhusu ulanguzi wa binadamu.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha uzungumzaji wa kupasha habari katika somo la Kiswahili na uzungumzaji huo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la ulanguzi wa binadamu na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies na Religious Studies.

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya kuzungumza ili kupasha habari ili kutofautisha na aina nyingine za uzungumzaji
kutambua aina za uzungumzaji wa kupasha habari
kujadili vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kuzungumza ili kupasha habari
kupasha habari kwa kutumia vipengele vifaavyo
kuchangamkia kupasha habari mbalimbali ili kufanikisha mawasiliano

skills.name: Zungumza ili kupasha habari
skills.mastery: Names the features to keep in this kind of talk (kupasha), picks the better of two ways to listen or reply in a situation on tahadhari kuhusu ulaguzi wa binadamu, and takes part in one in standard Kiswahili, judged by the teacher with the KICD rubric; in the app, 8 of 10 new items right.

prerequisites.reason: Listening and replying come before informing others.
Formal language for formal settings.

misconceptions.error: Gives news without the facts the listener needs (who, what, when, where).

example.question: Unapasha habari ya mkutano. Ni ipi kamili?
example.correct_answer: Kutakuwa na mkutano wa wazazi Jumamosi saa nne asubuhi ukumbini.

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the facts and forgets the listener does not.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unapasha habari ya mkutano. Ni ipi kamili?" with "Kuna mkutano." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Check the news against nani, nini, lini, wapi.
misconceptions.feedback: Habari kamili hujibu nani, nini, lini na wapi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Mixes his opinion with the facts when giving information.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ni habari tu?

misconceptions.cause: Telling news and judging it are done together in chat.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ni habari tu?" with "Mkutano utakuwa wa kuchosha sana." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Mark each sentence fact or opinion.
misconceptions.feedback: Unapopasha habari, toa ukweli bila maoni yako.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses Sheng or English words in a formal talk.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika mazungumzo rasmi?

misconceptions.cause: The child talks as with friends.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika mazungumzo rasmi?" with "Ma-guys, hii issue ni serious." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Record and replay; replace each non-Kiswahili word.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia Kiswahili sanifu katika mazungumzo rasmi.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Listens or speaks without looking at the other person (looks down or away).

example.question: Ni ishara ipi inaonyesha unasikiliza kwa makini?

misconceptions.cause: Looking away is a sign of respect at home for some children; in class talk it reads as not listening.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni ishara ipi inaonyesha unasikiliza kwa makini?" with "kuangalia chini muda wote" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Practise in pairs: listen with eyes on the speaker and nods; then swap.
misconceptions.feedback: Mwangalie mzungumzaji ili aone unamsikiliza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Kina (Theme 8: Ulaguzi wa binadamu)
learning_experiences: kueleza maana ya mandhari katika fasihi,
kutambua mandhari mbalimbali katika novela iliyoteuliwa na mwalimu,
kujadili umuhimu wa mandhari ya novela iliyoteuliwa na mwalimu,
kuwawasilishia wenzake darasani uchambuzi wake kuhusu mandhari,
kuandika maelezo mafupi kuhusu mandhari ya novela iliyoteuliwa na mwalimu,
kueleza maana ya ploti katika fasihi,
kutambua ploti ya novela iliyoteuliwa na mwalimu,
kujadili umuhimu wa ploti ya novela iliyoteuliwa na mwalimu akishirikiana na wenzake,
kuandika maelezo mafupi kuhusu ploti ya novela iliyoteuliwa na mwalimu,
kuwawasilishia wenzake darasani uchambuzi wake kuhusu ploti,
kumsomea mzazi au mlezi novela iliyochapishwa au kutoka mtandaoni na kutambua mandhari na ploti yake.
key_inquiry_questions: Ni mandhari gani unayokumbuka yaliyo katika kazi za fasihi ulizowahi kusoma?
Ploti ya hadithi ina vipengele gani?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapotambua na kujadili mandhari na ploti katika novela akiwa na wenzake katika kikundi.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapowasilisha kazi yake darasani.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapochanganua habari katika novela ili kupata mandhari na ploti.
Uwazaji kina: mwanafunzi anapoeleza umuhimu wa mandhari na ploti katika novela.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapotafiti na kujiandaa ili awawasilishie wenzake muhtasari wa mandhari na ploti.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake wanapotambua na kujadili mandhari na ploti kwenye novela katika kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapotoa maoni kuhusu uwasilishaji wa wengine ili kuwarekebisha na kuwahimiza.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anaposoma na kuchanganua novela.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wengine katika kikundi ili kutambua na kujadili mandhari na ploti kwenye novela.
sub_strands.pcis: anuwai kulingana na maudhui yaliyoangaziwa katika novela.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya mandhari na ploti katika novela katika somo la Kiswahili na dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la ulanguzi wa binadamu na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies na Religious Studies.
Shughuli za Ujifunzaji Maswali Dadisi

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya mandhari na ploti katika fasihi
kutambua mandhari mbalimbali na ploti ya novela
kueleza umuhimu wa mandhari na ploti ya novela
kuandika maelezo mafupi kuhusu mandhari na ploti ya novela aliyosoma
kuchangamkia nafasi ya mandhari na ploti katika kazi ya fasihi

skills.name: Eleza mandhari na ploti ya novela
skills.mastery: Explains the mandhari of a novela read in class ("Kisima cha Matumaini") with a correct term, gives evidence from the text for every point, and says why it matters to the work, in 8 of 10 new items (longer written answers marked by the teacher).

prerequisites.reason: Themes come before setting and plot.
Ordering events is the base of ploti.

misconceptions.error: Gives only the place as mandhari, and leaves out the time and the social setting.

example.question: Mandhari ya "Kisima cha Matumaini" ni yapi?
example.correct_answer: kijiji cha Mwangaza, wakati wa kiangazi kirefu

misconceptions.cause: Mandhari is first taught as "mahali".
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mandhari ya "Kisima cha Matumaini" ni yapi?" with "kijiji cha Mwangaza" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Make three boxes: mahali, wakati, hali ya kijamii; fill each from the text.
misconceptions.feedback: Mandhari ni mahali, wakati na hali ambamo matukio yanatokea.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives a list of the characters, or a summary of the message, as the ploti.

example.question: Ploti ya "Kisima cha Matumaini" ni nini?
example.wrong_answer: orodha ya wahusika: Neema na Baraka
example.correct_answer: mfuatano wa matukio tangu mwanzo hadi mwisho

misconceptions.cause: Ploti is a new word and the child grabs what he knows about the work.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ploti ya "Kisima cha Matumaini" ni nini?" with "orodha ya wahusika: Neema na Baraka" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ploti is the chain of events with cause: because A, then B. Build it with event cards and arrows.
misconceptions.feedback: Ploti ni msuko wa matukio na jinsi yanavyofuatana.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts the events of the ploti in the order he remembers them, not the order of the story.

example.question: Ni tukio lipi huja kwanza katika ploti ya "Kisima cha Matumaini"?
example.correct_answer: tukio la mwanzo kabisa la kazi

misconceptions.cause: The climax is remembered first.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni tukio lipi huja kwanza katika ploti ya "Kisima cha Matumaini"?" with "Neema anagundua kisima kimefungwa" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Number the events on the page; then check the order against the chapters or scenes.
misconceptions.feedback: Fuata mpangilio wa matukio kama yalivyo katika kazi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Names the mandhari but cannot say why it matters to the story (it is "just where it happened").

example.question: Mandhari ya kijiji cha Mwangaza yana umuhimu gani katika "Kisima cha Matumaini"?
example.correct_answer: yanaonyesha hali ya wahusika na kuchangia ufisadi na uhaba wa maji

misconceptions.cause: Setting has been taught as a fact to find, not as a tool of the author.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mandhari ya kijiji cha Mwangaza yana umuhimu gani katika "Kisima cha Matumaini"?" with "ni mahali tu hadithi ilipotokea" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask: could the story happen the same way anywhere else? What does this place add?
misconceptions.feedback: Mandhari hujenga hali, huonyesha maudhui na huathiri matendo ya wahusika.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Viakifishi (Theme 8: Ulaguzi wa binadamu)
learning_experiences: kutambua matumizi ya kiulizi (k.v. mwishoni mwa sentensi ya swali) na koma (k.v. kutenga orodha ya vitu au kuandika anwani) katika maneno, sentensi au vifungu vya maneno kwenye matini andishi au za kidijitali,
kutumia kifaa cha kidijitali kusoma matumizi ya kiulizi na koma,
kuandika maneno, sentensi au vifungu vya maneno kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kutumia kiulizi na koma ipasavyo,

skills.name: Tofautisha sauti /d/ na /nd/ katika silabi, maneno na vitanzandimi
skills.mastery: Hears, says and writes the right sound in syllables and words with /d/ na /nd/ (doa and ndoa, dama and ndama), picks the word that matches the meaning, and tells a real kitanzandimi from an ordinary sentence, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Theme 2 practised close sounds this year.
Grade 6 d/nd with other nasal pairs.

misconceptions.error: Hears or says /nd/ for /d/, so doa (a stain) becomes ndoa (a marriage).

example.question: Mwalimu anasema: "doa". Umesikia neno lipi?

misconceptions.cause: The nasal (n- or m-) before d is soft and quick; a child who does not hear it writes and says the word without it, or adds it where it does not belong, and the meaning changes.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mwalimu anasema: "doa". Umesikia neno lipi?" with "ndoa" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Say the pair slowly with a hand on the throat (or watching the lips); the child says which word was heard before writing.
misconceptions.feedback: Sikiliza tena: "doa" ina sauti /d/. "ndoa" ni neno lingine lenye maana nyingine.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes the word with the letter of the other sound (ndama where dama is meant).

example.question: Jaza pengo: ___ maana yake ni "draughts (the board game)".

misconceptions.cause: The child spells as he speaks; if the two sounds are one sound in his speech, the letter is a guess.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza pengo: ___ maana yake ni "draughts (the board game)"." with "ndama" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Pair each spelling with its meaning on a card; the child sorts the cards by meaning, then by letter.
misconceptions.feedback: Neno lenye maana ya "draughts (the board game)" ni "dama". "ndama" lina maana ya "a calf".
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Thinks the two words are one word said in two ways, with one meaning.

example.question: "dama" na "ndama" ni maneno yenye maana moja?

misconceptions.cause: The child has heard both said by different people for the same thing and takes the difference for an accent.
misconceptions.reveals: The question ""dama" na "ndama" ni maneno yenye maana moja?" with "ndiyo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Use both words in two sentences that cannot swap: the child says which sentence breaks.
misconceptions.feedback: Hapana. "dama" ni draughts (the board game), na "ndama" ni a calf.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes any long sentence for a kitanzandimi, though it does not repeat the target sounds.

example.question: Ni kipi ni kitanzandimi?
example.wrong_answer: Simu yangu mpya ina kamera nzuri.
example.correct_answer: Ndege wa Dadi alidondoka ndani ya ndoo ya dada.

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks a kitanzandimi is any sentence that is hard to say, not one built by repeating close sounds.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni kipi ni kitanzandimi?" with "Simu yangu mpya ina kamera nzuri." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Underline the target sounds in the real kitanzandimi; count them; the ordinary sentence has few or none.
misconceptions.feedback: Kitanzandimi hurudia sauti zinazokaribiana, kama /d/ na /nd/, ili kiwe kigumu kutamka.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Splits the syllable with the nasal wrongly (n-doa instead of keeping the nasal with its consonant).

example.question: Neno "ndoa" lina silabi zipi?

misconceptions.cause: In Kiswahili every syllable ends in a vowel, and a nasal with its consonant (nd, mb, nj, ng) starts one syllable; the child splits by letters, not by sound.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Neno "ndoa" lina silabi zipi?" with "n-doa" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Clap the word: one clap per vowel; the nasal goes with the consonant after it.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila silabi ya Kiswahili huishia kwa irabu: ndo-a.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher
