kuandika insha ya masimulizi akizingatia sehemu ya mwanzo, kati na hitimisho,
kuwasomea wenzake insha aliyoandika au awasambazie kwenye vifaa vya kidijitali ili waitolee maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Ni sehemu gani kuu katika mpangilio wa matukio ya insha ya masimulizi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapoandika na kuwasomea wenzake insha aliyoiandika.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusambazia insha.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya masimulizi yenye kuzingatia vipengele vifaavyo vya kujenga wazo.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapowasomea wenzake insha aliyoandika ili waikosoe pamoja.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kuandika na kuwasomea wenzake insha.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapopewa nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani na katika kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis: Utunzi na haki za watoto: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi, anaposahihisha insha na wenzake na kujifunza ukakamavu, stahamala na kujiamini.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha uandishi wa insha ya masimulizi katika somo la Kiswahili na uandishi huo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali katika mawasiliano na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Pre-technical Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua vipengele vinavyozingatiwa kujenga wazo katika insha ya masimulizi
kueleza vipengele vinavyojenga wazo katika insha ya masimulizi
kuandika insha ya masimulizi akikuza wazo katika aya ipasavyo
kufurahia utunzi wa insha za masimulizi zenye mpangilio mzuri wa wazo

skills.name: Andika insha ya masimulizi ukikuza wazo katika kila aya
skills.mastery: Tells insha ya kubuni from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes a creative story built paragraph by paragraph, with characters, a setting and vivid language; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Theme 6 wrote a story with clear detail.
Grade 6 wrote masimulizi with a plan, a flow and a closing.

misconceptions.error: Puts several ideas in one paragraph, or one idea across many tiny paragraphs, so no idea is built up.

example.question: Aya nzuri ya insha "Ujumbe Uliobadilisha Maisha Yangu" ina nini?
example.correct_answer: wazo moja kuu linalokuzwa kwa maelezo na mifano

misconceptions.cause: Paragraphs are made where the child pauses, not where an idea ends.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Aya nzuri ya insha "Ujumbe Uliobadilisha Maisha Yangu" ina nini?" with "mawazo mengi tofauti" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Topic sentence first; then two or three sentences that develop only it; a link to the next paragraph.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila aya ikuze wazo moja kuu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Switches between "I" and "he" for the narrator, or between views, in one insha.

example.question: Ni lipi ni kosa katika insha moja?
example.correct_answer: kutumia nafsi moja ya msimulizi tangu mwanzo hadi mwisho

misconceptions.cause: The child forgets who is telling the story.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni lipi ni kosa katika insha moja?" with "kuanza "nilikwenda..." kisha "alikwenda..." kwa msimulizi yuleyule" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Decide the narrator before writing; circle every verb of the narrator and check the person.
misconceptions.feedback: Dumisha nafsi na mtazamo mmoja wa msimulizi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: States feelings with one word (nilihuzunika) and never shows them, so the reader feels nothing.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inamgusa msomaji zaidi?
example.correct_answer: Machozi yalinitiririka nilipoona kibanda chetu kikiteketea.

misconceptions.cause: Showing a feeling needs words for the body and the scene.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inamgusa msomaji zaidi?" with "Nilihuzunika." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Turn "nilihuzunika" into what the body did and what was seen.
misconceptions.feedback: Onyesha hisia kwa vitendo na picha, si kwa neno moja tu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts the events in an order that cannot have happened (the end before the start), with no linking words.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Ujumbe Uliobadilisha Maisha Yangu"?
example.wrong_answer: tuliripoti kwa polisi, tuligundua ni utapeli, nilimwonyesha mama, nilipokea ujumbe
example.correct_answer: nilipokea ujumbe, nilimwonyesha mama, tuligundua ni utapeli, tuliripoti kwa polisi

misconceptions.cause: The child writes events as they come to mind; nobody has asked for a plan first.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Ujumbe Uliobadilisha Maisha Yangu"?" with "tuliripoti kwa polisi, tuligundua ni utapeli, nilimwonyesha mama, nilipokea ujumbe" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Plan with three boxes (mwanzo, kati, mwisho) and linking words (kwanza, kisha, hatimaye) before writing.
misconceptions.feedback: Panga matukio yanavyofuatana, na utumie maneno kama kwanza, kisha na hatimaye.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Ngeli na Upatanisho wa Kisarufi (Theme 9: Matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali katika mawasiliano)
learning_experiences: kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi vya ngeli ya KI-VI na LI-YA katika sentensi na mafungu ya maneno,
kujaza nafasi katika sentensi au vifungu vifupi kwa kuzingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya KI-VI na LI-YA,
kuchopoa nomino za ngeli ya KI-VI na LI-YA kwenye chati, kadi maneno, kapu maneno au tarakilishi,
kutaja majina ya vitu katika mazingira ya shuleni yaliyo katika ngeli ya KI-VI na LI-YA,
kutenga nomino za ngeli ya KI-VI na LI-YA katika orodha ya nomino, sentensi au vifungu kwenye vitabu, tarakilishi, chati kwa kuzikolezea wino au kuzipigia mstari,

kutunga sentensi au vifungu vifupi vyenye upatanisho ufaao wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya KI-VI na LI-YA akizingatia masuala mtambuko mbalimbali likiwemo suala la matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali katika mawasiliano,
kuwasilisha kazi yake darasani au kuwasambazia wenzake mtandaoni ili waitolee maoni,
kutunga sentensi zenye upatanisho ufaao wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya KI-VI na LI-YA akitumia nomino za vitu vilivyo katika mazingira ya nyumbani, na kumsomea mzazi au mlezi wake ili amtolee maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Utajuaje kama matini inazingatia kanuni za kisarufi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki na kuchangia katika kazi za kikundi.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi au vifungu vifupi akitumia nomino za ngeli ya KI-VI na LI-YA.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kuunda sentensi au vifungu vifupi kwa kuzingatia upatanisho ufaao wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya KI-VI na LI-YA.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapomsomea mzazi au mlezi wake sentensi alizotunga kwa kutumia nomino za ngeli ya KI-VI na LI-YA katika mazingira ya nyumbani.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani na katika kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis:
Mshikamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anapochangia na kushirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi.
Usalama mtandaoni: mwanafunzi anapoandika kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kutumia nomino katika ngeli ya KI-VI na LI-YA.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya ngeli na upatanisho wa kisarufi katika somo la Kiswahili na dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali katika mawasiliano na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Pre-technical Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi vya ngeli ya KI-VI na LI-YA katika sentensi
kutambua nomino za ngeli ya KI-VI na LI-YA katika matini
kutumia nomino za ngeli ya KI-VI na LI-YA katika matini kwa kuzingatia upatanisho ufaao wa kisarufi
kuchangamkia kutumia nomino za ngeli ya KI-VI na LI-YA katika matini

skills.name: Tumia ngeli za KI-VI na LI-YA na upatanisho wa kisarufi
skills.mastery: Mtoto hutambua nomino za KI-VI (kitabu: vi-) na LI-YA (jiwe: ma-) na hutumia viambishi vya upatanisho (ki-/vi-, li-/ya-). Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Grade 4 KI-VI.
Grade 4 LI-YA.

misconceptions.error: Puts kitabu in LI-YA.

example.question: Kitabu ni cha ngeli gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "LI-YA" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Kitabu ni cha ngeli ya KI-VI; wingi wake ni vitabu.
misconceptions.feedback: Kitabu ni cha ngeli ya KI-VI; wingi wake ni vitabu.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Puts jiwe in KI-VI.

example.question: Jiwe ni la ngeli gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "KI-VI" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Jiwe ni la ngeli ya LI-YA; wingi wake ni mawe.
misconceptions.feedback: Jiwe ni la ngeli ya LI-YA; wingi wake ni mawe.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Uses the wrong agreement prefix.

example.question: Chagua sentensi sahihi.

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "Kitabu kimeanguka na vitabu limeanguka" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: KI-VI: ki-, vi-. LI-YA: li-, ya-.
misconceptions.feedback: KI-VI: ki-, vi-. LI-YA: li-, ya-.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Misses that ch- nouns (chakula, choo, chumba) are KI-VI and puts them elsewhere (chakula imeiva).

example.question: Jaza: Chakula ___ (kimeiva / imeiva).

misconceptions.cause: The ki- prefix is hidden as ch- before a vowel.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: Chakula ___ (kimeiva / imeiva)." with "imeiva" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Show the plural: chakula -> vyakula, chumba -> vyumba: ch-/vy- is ki-/vi- before a vowel.
misconceptions.feedback: Chakula ni KI-VI (vyakula): chakula kimeiva.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Nyimbo (Theme 10: Kujithamini)
learning_experiences: kusikiliza kielelezo cha wimbo wa kazi na wa dini kutoka kwa mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa au kifaa cha kidijitali,
kueleza maana ya nyimbo za kazi na za dini ili kuzibainisha,
kutambua mazingira ambapo nyimbo za kazi na za dini huimbwa,
kueleza ujumbe katika nyimbo za kazi na za dini,
kuwasilisha nyimbo za kazi na za dini kuzingatia hisia na ishara,
kujirekodi akiimba nyimbo za kazi na za dini kwa kutumia vifaa vya kidijitali na kusikiliza akiwa na wenzake.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, unajua nyimbo zipi katika jamii yako?
Je, nyimbo za kazi na za dini zinatofautianaje?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapoeleza ujumbe katika nyimbo za kazi na za dini.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali katika kusikiliza nyimbo mbalimbali za kazi na za dini. Pia anapojirekodi akiimba nyimbo za kazi na za dini.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapowasilisha nyimbo za kazi na za dini akizingatia hisia na ishara za mwili zifaazo.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapowasilisha nyimbo kwa wepesi na ukakamavu.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za uimbaji.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapochukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi na pia kutunza vifaa vya kidijitali anavyotumia.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis:
Haki za watoto: mwanafunzi anapotunga na kuwasilisha nyimbo za kazi na za dini.
Masuala mtambuko anuwai kulingana na maudhui yaliyoangaziwa katika nyimbo.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha uwasilishaji wa nyimbo katika somo la Kiswahili na uwasilishaji huo katika somo la English, na Creative Arts and Sports.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la kujithamini na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies.

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya nyimbo za kazi na za dini ili kuzibainisha
kutambua mazingira ambapo nyimbo za kazi na za dini huimbwa
kueleza ujumbe katika nyimbo za kazi na za dini
kuwasilisha nyimbo za kazi na za dini kwa kuzingatia hisia na ishara za mwili
kuchangamkia nyimbo za kazi na za dini kama vipera vya fasihi simulizi

skills.name: Eleza maana, aina na sifa za nyimbo
skills.mastery: Explains the maana of nyimbo (wimbo wa kazi, wimbo wa dini) with the right terms and examples, gives evidence or a reason for each point, and presents one with its formula, voice, gestures and audience part (presentation scored by the teacher), in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Theme 4 met lullabies and children's songs.
The kinds of literature.

misconceptions.error: Mixes the two kinds (wimbo wa kazi and wimbo wa dini) and their purposes.

example.question: "Tupige jembe pamoja, shamba letu litastawi" ni nyimbo ya aina gani?

misconceptions.cause: Both are nyimbo; the child has not fixed what each is for and when it is used.
misconceptions.reveals: The question ""Tupige jembe pamoja, shamba letu litastawi" ni nyimbo ya aina gani?" with "wimbo wa dini" among the options.
misconceptions.help: List for each kind: who uses it, when, and why; sort examples.
misconceptions.feedback: "Tupige jembe pamoja, shamba letu litastawi" ni wimbo wa kazi: kazi ya pamoja huwa nyepesi na huleta mafanikio.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Calls nyimbo written literature because it is found in a textbook.

example.question: Nyimbo ni utanzu wa fasihi ipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child meets it on the page in class.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Nyimbo ni utanzu wa fasihi ipi?" with "fasihi andishi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask: who first made it, and how was it passed on? By mouth, from one generation to the next.
misconceptions.feedback: Nyimbo ni fasihi simulizi: hupokezwa kwa mdomo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Places the nyimbo in the wrong occasion (a lullaby at a work party, a work song at a funeral).

example.question: Wimbo wa kazi hutumika lini?
example.correct_answer: watu wanapolima au kufanya kazi pamoja

misconceptions.cause: The occasion is not stated in the text, and the child does not link form to use.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Wimbo wa kazi hutumika lini?" with "wakati wowote" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Act out the occasion; which kind fits it?
misconceptions.feedback: Wimbo wa kazi hutumika watu wanapolima au kufanya kazi pamoja.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives a line of the text as its message instead of the lesson.

example.question: Ujumbe wa "Tupige jembe pamoja, shamba letu litastawi" ni upi?
example.wrong_answer: Tupige jembe pamoja, shamba letu litastawi
example.correct_answer: kazi ya pamoja huwa nyepesi na huleta mafanikio.

misconceptions.cause: Copying a line feels like a safe answer.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ujumbe wa "Tupige jembe pamoja, shamba letu litastawi" ni upi?" with "Tupige jembe pamoja, shamba letu litastawi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Close the text; say the lesson in your own words.
misconceptions.feedback: Ujumbe ni funzo kwa maneno yako mwenyewe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Kina (Theme 10: Kujithamini)
learning_experiences: kutambua wahusika katika novela iliyoteuliwa na mwalimu,
kujadili sifa za wahusika katika novela iliyoteuliwa na mwalimu,
kuigiza wahusika katika novela iliyoteuliwa na mwalimu ili kukuza uelewa wa sifa zao,
kueleza uhusiano kati ya wahusika katika novela iliyoteuliwa na mwalimu,
kutazama video kuhusu wahusika katika novela iliyoteuliwa na mwalimu,
kuandaa muhtasari kuhusu sifa za wahusika katika video aliyotazama,
kujadili mafunzo yanayotokana na matendo ya wahusika,
kumsimulia mzazi au mlezi wake hadithi ya novela na kujadiliana kuhusu wahusika wawili.
key_inquiry_questions: Ni mambo yapi yanayokuwezesha kuwaelewa wahusika katika novela?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapoigiza na wenzake wahusika katika novela.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoigiza wahusika katika novela.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapochambua sifa za wahusika katika novela.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika majadiliano ya kuwachambua wahusika katika kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis: Kujithamini: mwanafunzi anapoigiza wahusika katika novela.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya wahusika wa novela katika somo la Kiswahili na dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la kujithamini na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua wahusika katika novela
kujadili sifa za wahusika katika novela
kueleza uhusiano kati ya wahusika katika novela
kuandika muhtasari wa sifa za wahusika katika novela
kujadili mafunzo yanayotokana na matendo ya wahusika katika novela
kujenga mazoea ya usomaji wa kazi za kifasihi katika maisha ya kila siku

skills.name: Chambua wahusika na sifa zao katika novela
skills.mastery: Explains the wahusika of a novela read in class ("Kisima cha Matumaini") with a correct term, gives evidence from the text for every point, and says why it matters to the work, in 8 of 10 new items (longer written answers marked by the teacher).

prerequisites.reason: Setting and plot frame the characters.
Grade 6 found characters in a play.

misconceptions.error: Takes a minor character who appears often for the main character.

example.question: Mhusika mkuu katika "Kisima cha Matumaini" ni nani?

misconceptions.cause: The child counts appearances, not who the story is about.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mhusika mkuu katika "Kisima cha Matumaini" ni nani?" with "Baraka" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask whose problem the story follows from start to end.
misconceptions.feedback: Mhusika mkuu ni yule ambaye kazi inamhusu tangu mwanzo hadi mwisho.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives a trait with no action from the text to show it.

example.question: Neema ni jasiri. Ni ushahidi upi unaothibitisha?
example.wrong_answer: ni jasiri kwa sababu ni mhusika mzuri
example.correct_answer: alienda kwa chifu peke yake kuripoti wizi wa maji

misconceptions.cause: The child knows a trait must be named but not that it must be shown.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Neema ni jasiri. Ni ushahidi upi unaothibitisha?" with "ni jasiri kwa sababu ni mhusika mzuri" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Use the frame: trait + "kwa sababu" + an action from the text.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila sifa ithibitishwe kwa kitendo cha mhusika katika kazi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives how the character looks (mrefu, mrembo) when the character's nature is asked.

example.question: Taja sifa ya kitabia ya Neema.

misconceptions.cause: Describing people starts with appearance in lower grades.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Taja sifa ya kitabia ya Neema." with "mrefu na mwembamba" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Two columns: sura (looks) and tabia (character); sort the words.
misconceptions.feedback: Sifa za kitabia ni kama ukarimu, uchoyo, ujasiri; si urefu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes the behaviour of a bad character as the lesson to copy.

example.question: Tunajifunza nini kutokana na matendo ya Bwana Tajiri?
example.correct_answer: tuepuke tabia mbaya kama zake kwa sababu zina madhara

misconceptions.cause: The bad character often wins for a while, and the child sees the gain, not the end.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Tunajifunza nini kutokana na matendo ya Bwana Tajiri?" with "tufanye kama yeye ili tufanikiwe" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Follow the character to the end of the work: what did his actions bring?
misconceptions.feedback: Tunajifunza kuepuka tabia mbaya kwa kuona matokeo yake.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Msamaha (Theme 10: Kujithamini)
learning_experiences: kueleza umuhimu wa kuandika barua rasmi ya kuomba msamaha kuhusu matukio mbalimbali,
kutambua ujumbe unaoafiki barua rasmi ya kuomba msamaha kwa kujadiliana na mwenzake,
kujadili na wenzake vipengele vya kimuundo vya barua rasmi ya kuomba msamaha,
kujadili na wenzake kuhusu lugha inayofaa katika uandishi wa barua rasmi ya kuomba msamaha,
kuandika barua rasmi ya kuomba msamaha kuhusu matukio mbalimbali na kuwasomea wenzake darasani ili waitolee maoni,
kuandika barua rasmi ya kuomba msamaha katika kifaa cha kidijitali na kuwasambazia wenzake kupitia mtandao ili waitolee maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni mambo gani yanayoweza kukufanya uandike barua rasmi ya kuomba msamaha?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki na wenzake katika kujadili vipengele vya barua rasmi ya kuomba msamaha.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika barua rasmi ya kuomba msamaha.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapowaza kuhusu matukio yanayomfanya mtu kuomba msamaha.
Uraia: mwanafunzi anapoomba msamaha anajenga mshikamano katika jamii au taifa.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowapa nafasi wenzake kuchangia katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.pcis: Mshikamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anapoandika barua ya kuomba msamaha.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha uandishi wa barua rasmi ya kuomba msamaha katika somo la Kiswahili na uandishi huo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la kujithamini na dhana ya msamaha katika somo la Kiswahili na dhana hiyo katika somo la Social Studies na Religious Studies.

outcomes.text: kueleza umuhimu wa barua rasmi ya kuomba msamaha
kutambua ujumbe katika barua rasmi ya kuomba msamaha
kutambua vipengele vya kimuundo vya barua rasmi ya kuomba msamaha
kuandika barua rasmi ya kuomba msamaha kwa kuzingatia ujumbe, muundo na lugha ifaayo
kufurahia kujieleza kwa njia ifaayo kupitia kwa barua

skills.name: Tambua muundo wa barua rasmi ya kuomba msamaha
skills.mastery: Mtoto hutambua vipengele vya barua rasmi (anwani mbili, tarehe, salamu rasmi, kichwa, ujumbe, hitimisho) na lugha ya heshima. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Grade 6 parts of an official letter.

skills.name: Andika barua rasmi ya kuomba msamaha
skills.mastery: Tells barua rasmi from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes an official letter with two addresses, the date, a formal greeting, a KUH: line, the message and Wako mtiifu with a signature; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: The parts of an apology letter come before writing one.
Grade 6 wrote official letters.

misconceptions.error: Gives one address in a formal letter.

example.question: Barua rasmi ina anwani ngapi?
example.correct_answer: mbili: ya mwandishi na ya mwandikiwa

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "moja" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Barua rasmi ina anwani mbili.
misconceptions.feedback: Barua rasmi ina anwani mbili.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Leaves out the heading of a formal letter.

example.question: Barua rasmi huwa na nini kabla ya ujumbe?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "hakuna kitu" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Barua rasmi ina kichwa cha barua.
misconceptions.feedback: Barua rasmi ina kichwa cha barua.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Uses slang in a formal letter.

example.question: Lugha ya barua rasmi ni ipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "ya mtaani" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Barua rasmi hutumia lugha ya heshima na sanifu.
misconceptions.feedback: Barua rasmi hutumia lugha ya heshima na sanifu.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Writes only one address, or puts the receiver's address at the top right.

example.question: Barua rasmi ina anwani ngapi?
example.correct_answer: mbili: ya mwandishi (kulia juu) na ya mpokeaji (kushoto)

misconceptions.cause: The friendly letter has one address and the child carries it over.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Barua rasmi ina anwani ngapi?" with "moja, ya mwandishi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Label both addresses on a model; the child writes his own and the receiver's on a blank layout.
misconceptions.feedback: Barua rasmi ina anwani mbili: ya mwandishi kulia juu, ya mpokeaji kushoto chini yake.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Leaves out the subject line (KUH: or YAH:) or writes it as a long sentence.

example.question: Ni kichwa kipi kinafaa katika barua rasmi kuhusu ombi la msamaha kwa kuchelewa shuleni?
example.wrong_answer: Nimeandika barua hii kwa sababu ninataka kukueleza mambo mengi.
example.correct_answer: KUH: OMBI LA MSAMAHA KWA KUCHELEWA SHULENI

misconceptions.cause: The child does not know the reader of an official letter needs the subject before reading.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni kichwa kipi kinafaa katika barua rasmi kuhusu ombi la msamaha kwa kuchelewa shuleni?" with "Nimeandika barua hii kwa sababu ninataka kukueleza mambo mengi." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Underline the KUH: line on three real letters; it is short and in capitals.
misconceptions.feedback: Kichwa cha barua rasmi huanza KUH: au YAH: na huandikwa kwa herufi kubwa, kwa ufupi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses friendly words in an official letter (Mpendwa rafiki, Hujambo?, Wako akupendaye).

example.question: Ni salamu ipi inafaa katika barua kwa Mwalimu Mkuu?

misconceptions.cause: The friendly letter is the first letter learnt and its words come first.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni salamu ipi inafaa katika barua kwa Mwalimu Mkuu?" with "Hujambo mwalimu wangu mpendwa!" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Sort salamu and closing cards into "kirafiki" and "rasmi".
misconceptions.feedback: Barua rasmi hutumia lugha rasmi: Kwa Mwalimu Mkuu, Wako mtiifu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Ends with only a first name and no signature, or with "Ni mimi rafiki yako".

example.question: Barua rasmi humalizika vipi?
example.correct_answer: Wako mtiifu, sahihi, na jina kamili: Wanjiku Kamau

misconceptions.cause: The friendly closing is a habit.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Barua rasmi humalizika vipi?" with "Ni mimi rafiki yako, Wanjiku" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Model the closing block (Wako mtiifu, sahihi, jina kamili) and have the child copy it once.
misconceptions.feedback: Barua rasmi humalizika kwa "Wako mtiifu," sahihi na jina kamili.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Explains or blames others at length but never actually says sorry or promises to change.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ni kiini cha barua ya kuomba msamaha?
example.wrong_answer: Basi la shule lilichelewa na dereva alikuwa mzembe.
example.correct_answer: Naomba msamaha kwa kuchelewa, na naahidi kufika mapema siku zijazo.

misconceptions.cause: The child wants to defend himself.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ni kiini cha barua ya kuomba msamaha?" with "Basi la shule lilichelewa na dereva alikuwa mzembe." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Plan: what happened (briefly), the apology, the promise.
misconceptions.feedback: Barua ya kuomba msamaha huomba msamaha wazi na kuahidi kubadilika.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Vinyume (Theme 10: Kujithamini)
learning_experiences: kueleza maana ya kinyume cha maneno,
kutambua vinyume vya nomino na vivumishi kwa kutumia kadi maneno, mti maneno au kapu maneno,
kutambua vinyume vya nomino na vivumishi katika orodha ya maneno, sentensi au vifungu,
kuchagua sentensi zinazoashiria matumizi ya vinyume vya nomino na vivumishi kutoka kwa sentensi mbalimbali kwenye vitabu, tarakilishi au chati,
kutumia vinyume vya nomino na vivumishi kujaza nafasi katika sentensi au vifungu,
kutunga sentensi au kifungu kifupi kwa kutumia vinyume vya nomino na vivumishi ipasavyo akizingatia masuala mtambuko mbalimbali likiwemo suala la kujithamini,
kusakura mtandaoni au katika vitabu vya ziada ili kupata vinyume zaidi vya nomino na vivumishi.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, dhana ya vinyume vya nomino ina maana gani?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapotoa mchango wake katika kazi ya kikundi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kutambua vinyume vya nomino na vivumishi.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi kuonyesha vinyume vya nomino na vivumishi.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kutambua vinyume vya nomino na vivumishi na kuvitungia sentensi sahihi.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis: Kujithamini: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi kuchopoa vinyume vya nomino na vivumishi na kutunga sentensi sahihi.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya vinyume vya maneno katika somo la Kiswahili na dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la kujithamini na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies.

outcomes.text: kueleza dhana ya kinyume cha maneno
kutambua vinyume vya nomino na vivumishi katika matini
kutumia vinyume vya nomino na vivumishi katika matini
kuchangamkia kutumia vinyume vya nomino na vivumishi katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Eleza na tumia vinyume vya nomino na vivumishi
skills.mastery: Mtoto hueleza kinyume cha neno (neno lenye maana kinyume) na hutambua vinyume vya nomino na vivumishi. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Grade 6 adjective opposites.

misconceptions.error: Thinks an antonym is a synonym.

example.question: Kinyume cha neno ni nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "Neno lenye maana sawa" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Kinyume cha neno ni neno lenye maana kinyume, kama kubwa na dogo.
misconceptions.feedback: Kinyume cha neno ni neno lenye maana kinyume, kama kubwa na dogo.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Gives the wrong antonym of an adjective.

example.question: Kinyume cha mrefu ni kipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "mnene" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Kinyume cha mrefu ni mfupi.
misconceptions.feedback: Kinyume cha mrefu ni mfupi.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Gives the wrong antonym of a noun.

example.question: Kinyume cha mchana ni kipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "asubuhi" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Kinyume cha mchana ni usiku.
misconceptions.feedback: Kinyume cha mchana ni usiku.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Gives the right opposite stem but drops the class prefix (mti mrefu -> mti fupi).

example.question: Kinyume cha "mti mrefu" ni?

misconceptions.cause: The child changes only the stem he looked up.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kinyume cha "mti mrefu" ni?" with "mti fupi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Keep the noun's prefix on the new adjective.
misconceptions.feedback: Kinyume huhifadhi kiambishi cha ngeli: mti mfupi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kuzungumza kwa Kuambatanisha na Vitendo/Ishara (Theme 11: Majukumu ya watoto)
learning_experiences: kueleza maana ya kuzungumza kwa kuambatanisha na vitendo,
kutambua umuhimu wa kuzungumza kwa kuambatanisha na vitendo au ishara (k.v. kumwelekeza mtu njia na kueleza jinsi ya kutayarisha chakula),
kuigiza jinsi ya kuzungumza kwa kuambatanisha na vitendo,
kushiriki na wenzake katika kikundi kusikiliza au kutazama mazungumzo yanayoambatanisha vitendo au ishara kutoka kwa mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa au kwenye vifaa vya kidijitali,
kujadili vitendo au ishara za kuambatanisha na mazungumzo,
kusikiliza au kutazama mazungumzo yanayoambatana na vitendo au ishara kuhusu suala lengwa na kubainisha vipengele vya kuzungumza kwa aina hii vilivyozingatiwa,
kuwasilisha mazungumzo yanayoambatana na vitendo au ishara kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kuzingatia vitendo au ishara zifaazo,
kushiriki na mzazi au mlezi wake katika kuzungumza kwa kuambatanisha na vitendo au ishara kuhusu suala lengwa.
key_inquiry_questions: Ni vitendo gani tunatumia tunapozungumza?
Kuna umuhimu gani wa kutumia vitendo tunapozungumza?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapotumia lugha nyepesi kuwaelimisha wenzake kuhusu majukumu ya watoto huku akiambatanisha na vitendo au ishara.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kuzungumza kwa kuambatanisha na vitendo na kufafanua namna ya kutekeleza jambo fulani.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapowasilisha mazungumzo kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kutumia mbinu zifaazo za kufanikisha mazungumzo.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapojadili na wenzake vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kuzungumza na kuambatanisha na vitendo katika kikundi.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake zamu ya kushiriki katika mazungumzo bila kuwakata kauli.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapovitunza vifaa vya kidijitali anavyovitumia kuwaelezea wenzake kuhusu suala fulani.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki na wengine na kuchangia katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis: Mshikamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki mazungumzo kwa kuambatanisha na vitendo kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha kuzungumza kwa kuambatanisha na vitendo au ishara katika somo la Kiswahili na dhana hiyo kakita somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la majukumu ya watoto na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies na Religious Studies.

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya kuzungumza kwa kuambatani-sha na vitendo au ishara
kutambua umuhimu wa kuzungumza kwa kuambatanisha na vitendo au ishara
kujadili vitendo au ishara vya kuambatanisha na mazungumzo
kutoa mazungumzo kwa kuyaambatanisha na vitendo au ishara zifaazo
kujenga mazoea ya kuzungumza kwa kuambatanisha na vitendo au ishara ili kufanikisha mawasiliano

skills.name: Zungumza ukiambatanisha vitendo na ishara
skills.mastery: Names the features to keep in this kind of talk (ishara), picks the better of two ways to listen or reply in a situation on majukumu ya watoto nyumbani, and takes part in one in standard Kiswahili, judged by the teacher with the KICD rubric; in the app, 8 of 10 new items right.

prerequisites.reason: Speaking to inform comes before adding gestures.
Grade 6 told a story with gestures.

misconceptions.error: Uses a gesture that says the opposite of the words (shakes the head while saying yes).

example.question: Unasema "Ndiyo, nimekubali." Ishara ipi inafaa?

misconceptions.cause: Gestures are habits and not checked.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unasema "Ndiyo, nimekubali." Ishara ipi inafaa?" with "kutikisa kichwa kushoto kulia" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Mirror game: say a line, partner checks the gesture.
misconceptions.feedback: Ishara ziendane na maneno.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses so many gestures that they distract from the words.

example.question: Ni lipi bora unapozungumza?

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks more gestures is better.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni lipi bora unapozungumza?" with "kusogeza mikono kila neno" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Choose three key words to gesture on.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia ishara chache zenye maana.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Listens or speaks without looking at the other person (looks down or away).

example.question: Ni ishara ipi inaonyesha unasikiliza kwa makini?

misconceptions.cause: Looking away is a sign of respect at home for some children; in class talk it reads as not listening.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni ishara ipi inaonyesha unasikiliza kwa makini?" with "kuangalia chini muda wote" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Practise in pairs: listen with eyes on the speaker and nods; then swap.
misconceptions.feedback: Mwangalie mzungumzaji ili aone unamsikiliza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses Sheng or English words in a formal talk.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika mazungumzo rasmi?

misconceptions.cause: The child talks as with friends.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika mazungumzo rasmi?" with "Ma-guys, hii issue ni serious." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Record and replay; replace each non-Kiswahili word.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia Kiswahili sanifu katika mazungumzo rasmi.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Mapana (Theme 11: Majukumu ya watoto)
learning_experiences: kueleza ujumbe wa matini ya kujichagulia aliyosoma,
kutambua msamiati uliotumiwa katika matini ya kujichagulia (andishi au ya kidijitali),
kutumia kamusi kutafuta maana za maneno asiyoyajua,
kujenga rekodi ya msamiati aliojifunza katika kitabu,
kutunga sentensi akitumia msamiati katika matini aliyoisoma na kuwasomea wenzake darasani,
kutoa muhtasari wa matini ya kujichagulia aliyosoma na kuwasilisha kwa wenzake ili waitolee maoni,
kusakura mtandaoni na kujichagulia matini ya ziada kisha aisome.
key_inquiry_questions: Unapenda kusoma matini za aina gani?
Unazingatia nini unapochagua matini ya kujisomea?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapotangamana na wenzake na kuwawasilishia muhtasari wa matini ya kujichagulia aliyosoma.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapomtungia mwenzake sentensi kutokana na msamiati wa matini ya kujichagulia akizingatia ufasaha wa lugha.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapomtungia mwenzake sentensi akitumia msamiati katika matini aliyoisoma.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapojichagulia matini ya kusoma na kutafuta maana za maneno asiyoyajua kwenye kamusi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anaposakura mtandaoni na kujichagulia matini ya kusoma.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake wanapowasilisha muhtasari wa matini ya kujichagulia waliyosoma.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kutafuta na kusoma matini aliyojichagulia. Pia anapozingatia nidhamu anaposakura mtandaoni.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutunga sentensi akitumia msamiati aliojifunza.
sub_strands.pcis: Majukumu ya watoto: mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha kusoma kwa mapana katika somo la Kiswahili na dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la majukumu ya watoto na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies na Religious Studies.

outcomes.text: kueleza ujumbe wa matini ya kujichagulia
kutambua msamiati uliotumiwa katika matini ya kujichagulia
kutumia ipasavyo msamiati aliosoma katika matini ya kujichagulia
kutoa muhtasari wa matini ya kujichagulia aliyosoma
kujenga mazoea ya kusoma matini mbalimbali katika maisha ya kila siku

skills.name: Chagua matini ya kusoma na ueleze ujumbe wake
skills.mastery: Chooses a text that suits his reading level and interest from its title, blurb and first page (not from the cover alone), tells the kind of text (hadithi, shairi, makala, gazeti), says its message in one sentence, and works out a new word from the sentence around it, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Theme 2 read a chosen text.
Summarising briefly.

misconceptions.error: Chooses a book by its cover picture or its thickness only.

example.question: Unataka kusoma kuhusu majukumu ya watoto. Utachaguaje kitabu?
example.correct_answer: kwa kusoma anwani, maelezo ya nyuma na ukurasa wa kwanza

misconceptions.cause: Nobody has shown the child the title, the blurb and the first page as clues.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unataka kusoma kuhusu majukumu ya watoto. Utachaguaje kitabu?" with "kwa picha nzuri ya jalada" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Hold up two books; read the title and the back of each aloud; the child chooses and says which clue decided it.
misconceptions.feedback: Anwani, maelezo ya nyuma ya kitabu na ukurasa wa kwanza hukuambia kitabu kinahusu nini.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Chooses a text far above his reading level and gives up after a page.

example.question: Ukisoma ukurasa wa kwanza wa "Kazi za Juma" na hujui maneno mengi sana, ufanye nini?
example.correct_answer: chagua matini nyingine iliyo ya kiwango chako

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks a harder book is a better book, or chooses the book a friend chose.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ukisoma ukurasa wa kwanza wa "Kazi za Juma" na hujui maneno mengi sana, ufanye nini?" with "endelea tu hata kama huelewi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: The five-finger check: on one page, a finger for each unknown word; five fingers means the book is too hard for now.
misconceptions.feedback: Matini ifaayo ni ile unayoweza kuisoma na kuielewa ukiwa peke yako.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the title as the message of the text.

example.question: Ujumbe wa matini "Kazi za Juma" ni upi?
example.correct_answer: Watoto wakitimiza majukumu yao, familia hustawi.

misconceptions.cause: The title is the only sentence about the whole text that the child is sure of.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ujumbe wa matini "Kazi za Juma" ni upi?" with "Kazi za Juma" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask what the writer wants the reader to learn or do; the title only names the topic.
misconceptions.feedback: Anwani hutaja mada; ujumbe ni funzo au wazo kuu ambalo mwandishi anataka ulipate.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives one detail of the text as its message.

example.question: Ni ipi ni ujumbe wa matini kuhusu majukumu ya watoto?
example.correct_answer: Watoto wakitimiza majukumu yao, familia hustawi.

misconceptions.cause: The detail was striking and is remembered; the child has not asked what the whole text is about.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni ipi ni ujumbe wa matini kuhusu majukumu ya watoto?" with "Juma alichota maji kisimani." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Two boxes: "ujumbe" (one) and "maelezo" (many); the child sorts sentences from the text.
misconceptions.feedback: Ujumbe unahusu matini yote; jambo moja dogo ni maelezo tu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Does not tell one kind of text from another (takes a newspaper report for a story, or a poem for a story).

example.question: Matini yenye beti na mishororo ni ya aina gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child has met most texts as "kitabu" and has not been shown the signs of each kind.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Matini yenye beti na mishororo ni ya aina gani?" with "hadithi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Lay out a story, a poem, a newspaper page and a dictionary; the child names one sign of each.
misconceptions.feedback: Shairi lina beti na mishororo; hadithi ina aya; gazeti lina habari na tarehe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Guesses a new word from how it looks, not from the sentence it is in (jukumu).

example.question: Katika matini: "Kila mtoto nyumbani ana jukumu lake." Neno "jukumu" lina maana gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child matches the word to a word it looks like instead of reading the sentence around it.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Katika matini: "Kila mtoto nyumbani ana jukumu lake." Neno "jukumu" lina maana gani?" with "chumba cha kulala" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Cover the word; the child reads the sentence and says what word would fit; then compares.
misconceptions.feedback: Soma sentensi nzima: "jukumu" hapa ni kazi ambayo mtu anapaswa kuifanya.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Insha za Kubuni (Theme 11: Majukumu ya watoto)
learning_experiences: kutambua mpangilio wa insha ya maelezo katika matini za kimaandishi au za kidijitali (k.v. mpangilio unaozingatia mahali, hasa kama maelezo yanahusu mahali na mpangilio unaozingatia mfuatano wa matukio kiwakati),
kueleza jinsi maelezo yalivyopangwa katika kielelezo cha insha ya maelezo,
kuandika vidokezo vya insha vinavyozingatia jinsi maelezo yalivyopangwa katika insha ya maelezo kuhusu suala lengwa,
kuandika insha ya maelezo akizingatia mpangilio ufaao wa maelezo,
kuwasomea wenzake insha aliyoiandika au awasambazie kwenye vifaa vya kidijitali ili waitolee maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, unawezaje kupanga matukio katika insha ya maelezo?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha na kuwasomea wenzake darasani.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kuwasambazia wenzake insha.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha yenye mpangilio mzuri wa maelezo.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapowasomea wenzake kwa ufasaha insha aliyoandika ili waikosoe pamoja.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha na kuwasomea wenzake.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapopewa nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani na katika kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis:
Mshikamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi na pia anaposahihisha insha na wenzake.
Majukumu ya watoto: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya maelezo kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha uandishi wa insha ya maelezo katika somo la Kiswahili na dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la majukumu ya watoto na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies na Religious Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua vipengele vya mpangilio wa insha ya maelezo
kueleza mpangilio wa insha ya maelezo
kuandika insha ya maelezo inayozingatia mpangilio ufaao wa maelezo
kufurahia kuandika insha za maelezo katika maisha ya kila siku akizingatia mpangilio ufaao wa maelezo

skills.name: Andika insha ya maelezo kwa mpangilio ufaao
skills.mastery: Tells insha ya maelezo from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes a description or explanation with exact vocabulary, ordered paragraphs and vivid language; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Theme 7 wrote a maelezo with exact vocabulary.
Grade 6 wrote maelezo in order with detail.

misconceptions.error: Gives the steps of how to do something in a mixed-up order.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi unafaa katika maelezo ya "Majukumu Yangu Nyumbani"?
example.wrong_answer: kujiandaa kwenda shule, kuchota maji, kufagia uwanja, kutandika kitanda
example.correct_answer: kutandika kitanda, kufagia uwanja, kuchota maji, kujiandaa kwenda shule

misconceptions.cause: The child remembers the steps as a set, not as a sequence.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi unafaa katika maelezo ya "Majukumu Yangu Nyumbani"?" with "kujiandaa kwenda shule, kuchota maji, kufagia uwanja, kutandika kitanda" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Act out the steps; number them; write them with kwanza, kisha, mwishowe.
misconceptions.feedback: Maelezo ya jinsi ya kufanya jambo hufuata hatua kwa mpangilio.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes the whole insha as one paragraph with no utangulizi, kiini and hitimisho.

example.question: Insha "Majukumu Yangu Nyumbani" ina sehemu zipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child writes until the space is full and has not planned the parts.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Insha "Majukumu Yangu Nyumbani" ina sehemu zipi?" with "aya moja ndefu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Fold the page into three; one part in each; one idea per paragraph in the middle.
misconceptions.feedback: Insha ina utangulizi, kiini chenye aya kadhaa, na hitimisho.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts in points that are not about the title.

example.question: Katika insha ya maelezo yenye anwani "Majukumu Yangu Nyumbani", ni sentensi ipi haifai?
example.wrong_answer: Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu.
example.correct_answer: Kwanza, ninaamka saa kumi na moja na kutandika kitanda changu.

misconceptions.cause: The child adds whatever he remembers so the insha is long enough.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Katika insha ya maelezo yenye anwani "Majukumu Yangu Nyumbani", ni sentensi ipi haifai?" with "Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read each sentence and ask: does it tell the reader about the title? Cross out the ones that do not.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila sentensi ya insha inapaswa kuhusu anwani.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses vague or repeated words (kitu, kizuri, sana sana) where an exact word is needed.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ina msamiati ufaao kuhusu "Majukumu Yangu Nyumbani"?
example.correct_answer: Kwanza, ninaamka saa kumi na moja na kutandika kitanda changu.

misconceptions.cause: The child writes as he talks and has a small store of exact words.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ina msamiati ufaao kuhusu "Majukumu Yangu Nyumbani"?" with "Ninafanya kazi nyingi nyumbani." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Keep a theme word bank; replace every "kitu" and "kizuri" from it.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia neno mahususi badala ya maneno ya jumla.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Mnyambuliko wa Vitenzi Kauli ya: (Theme 11: Majukumu ya watoto)
learning_experiences: kutambua vitenzi katika kauli ya kutenda, kutendea na kutendwa,
kuteua vitenzi katika kauli ya kutenda, kutendea na kutendwa, kwenye chati, kadi maneno, kapu maneno, sentensi na vifungu au tarakilishi,

Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapotambua viambishi vya kauli mbalimbali.

kuchangamkia kutumia ipasavyo vitenzi katika kauli ya kutenda, kutendea na kutendwa ili kujenga ufasaha wa lugha

skills.name: Tambua kauli za kutenda, kutendea na kutendwa
skills.mastery: Mtoto hutambua kutenda (pika), kutendea (pikia) na kutendwa (pikwa) na hutumia kitenzi katika kauli inayofaa. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

Grade 4 kutenda, kutendea, kutendwa.

misconceptions.error: Confuses kutendea with kutendwa.

example.question: Ni kitenzi kipi katika kauli ya kutendea?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "pikwa" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Kutendea huonyesha kwa ajili ya nani, kama pikia.
misconceptions.feedback: Kutendea huonyesha kwa ajili ya nani, kama pikia.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "pikia" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Kutendwa huonyesha anayepokea tendo, kama pikwa.

example.question: Ni kitenzi kipi katika kauli ya kutenda?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "pikwa" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Kutenda ni umbo la kawaida, kama pika.

misconceptions.error: Uses -iwa where -ewa is needed after e or o (somiwa for somewa), or the reverse.

example.question: Kauli ya kutendwa ya "soma" ni?

misconceptions.cause: The vowel rule of extended verbs is not yet fixed.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kauli ya kutendwa ya "soma" ni?" with "somiwa" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Sort stems by vowel: o/e take -e- (someka, somea), a/i/u take -i- (pikika, pikia); the passive of soma is somwa.
misconceptions.feedback: Kutendwa kwa "soma" ni "somwa".

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusikiliza kwa Makini (Theme 12: Magonjwa ambukizi)
learning_experiences: kutambua hoja muhimu katika habari aliyosikiliza kuhusu suala lengwa,
kusikiliza habari kuhusu suala lengwa na kutaja hoja muhimu kwa maneno machache,
kutafiti mtandaoni kuhusu suala lengwa na kuwawasilishia wenzake hoja muhimu kuhusu suala hilo kwa maneno machache,
kumsomea mzazi au mlezi habari kuhusu suala lengwa na kushirikiana kutambua hoja muhimu.
key_inquiry_questions: Kwa nini ni muhimu kutambua hoja katika habari uliyosikiliza?

Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anaposikiliza habari, kuichanganua na kutambua hoja muhimu.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoiwasilisha upya habari aliyosikiliza kupitia hoja kuu.
sub_strands.values:

Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali anavyotumia kujifunzia.

kutazama vielelezo vya video za watu wanaosoma makala kwa ufasaha (k.v. hotuba na habari),
