kusoma kifungu kwa kuambatanisha ishara zifaazo
kuridhia kusoma makala kwa kuzingatia vipengele vinavyofanikisha mawasiliano

skills.name: Soma kifungu kwa sauti kwa matamshi bora, kasi ifaayo, sauti ifaayo na ishara
skills.mastery: Reads a short passage aloud at a speaking pace, pauses at the koma and the kikomo, raises the voice for a question and shows feeling for an exclamation, says every sound clearly (no l for r), and uses a matching gesture, judged by the teacher with the KICD rubric; in the app picks the better reading of a line in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Theme 4 reading aloud.
The features of fluent reading.

misconceptions.error: Reads word by word or syllable by syllable, so the sentence has no meaning when heard.

example.question: Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Kunawa mikono kwa sabuni huzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa."?
example.wrong_answer: Kunawa ... mikono ... kwa ... sabuni ... huzuia ... kuenea ... kwa ... magonjwa.
example.correct_answer: Kunawa mikono kwa sabuni huzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa.

misconceptions.cause: The child is still decoding each word and has not yet learnt to read a phrase as one piece.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Kunawa mikono kwa sabuni huzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa."?" with "Kunawa ... mikono ... kwa ... sabuni ... huzuia ... kuenea ... kwa ... magonjwa." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Echo reading: the teacher reads a phrase, the child repeats it as one breath; then phrase-cut the passage with slashes.
misconceptions.feedback: Usomaji wa ufasaha husoma kundi la maneno kwa pamoja, kama tunavyozungumza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads as fast as possible and thinks the fastest reader is the best.

example.question: Ni kasi ipi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu darasani?
example.correct_answer: kasi ya kuzungumza, ili kila neno lisikike

misconceptions.cause: Reading races in class reward speed; the child has not been asked whether listeners understood.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni kasi ipi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu darasani?" with "haraka iwezekanavyo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Time two readings: one very fast, one at speaking pace; listeners answer one question after each.
misconceptions.feedback: Kasi ifaayo ni ile ya kuzungumza: si haraka mno, si polepole mno.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads a question and an exclamation in the same flat voice as a statement.

example.question: Sentensi "Je, umepata chanjo zote?" inasomwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida
example.correct_answer: sauti hupanda mwishoni kwa sababu ni swali

misconceptions.cause: The child looks at the words and not at the mark at the end.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Sentensi "Je, umepata chanjo zote?" inasomwa vipi?" with "kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read the same words three ways (. ? !); the child points at the mark that matches each reading.
misconceptions.feedback: Kiulizi (?) hupandisha sauti mwishoni; alama ya hisi (!) huonyesha hisia.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads on through the koma and the kikomo without a pause.

example.question: Unasoma: "Ole wetu, ugonjwa umeenea kijijini!" Unasimama wapi kidogo?
example.wrong_answer: hapana mahali, unasoma moja kwa moja
example.correct_answer: kwenye koma na kwenye kikomo au alama ya hisi

misconceptions.cause: The marks are read as decoration; the child has not linked them to breath.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unasoma: "Ole wetu, ugonjwa umeenea kijijini!" Unasimama wapi kidogo?" with "hapana mahali, unasoma moja kwa moja" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Clap once at a koma, twice at a kikomo while reading together.
misconceptions.feedback: Simama kidogo kwenye koma, na zaidi kwenye kikomo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Says /l/ for /r/ or /r/ for /l/ while reading (dalili read as darili).

example.question: Neno "dalili" linatamkwa vipi?

misconceptions.cause: The first language of the child does not separate these sounds, so the reading carries the home sound.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Neno "dalili" linatamkwa vipi?" with "darili" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Make a list of the passage words with the hard sound; practise them before reading the passage.
misconceptions.feedback: Tamka "dalili" kama lilivyoandikwa; "darili" ni neno jingine au si neno.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Hotuba ya Kupasha Habari (Theme 12: Magonjwa ambukizi)
learning_experiences: kueleza maana ya hotuba ya kupasha habari,
kujadiliana na wenzake kuhusu ujumbe, lugha na muundo ufaao wa hotuba ya kupasha habari,
kujadili na wenzake miktadha inayochochea hotuba ya kupasha habari,
kujadili na wenzake vidokezo vinavyoweza kutumiwa katika kuandika hotuba ya kupasha habari,
kuandika hotuba ya kupasha habari kuhusu suala lengwa akizingatia ujumbe, lugha na muundo ufaao kisha awasambazie wenzake mtandaoni au kuwasomea darasani ili waitolee maoni,
kuandika hotuba ya kupasha habari kuhusu suala linaloathiri jamii yao na kumsomea mzazi au mlezi wake.
key_inquiry_questions: Ni mambo yepi ambayo yanaweza kuelezwa kupitia kwa hotuba?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapotoa mchango wake katika kikundi kuhusu hotuba ya kupasha habari.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia tarakilishi kuandika hotuba ya kupasha habari na kuisambaza kwa mtandao.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika hotuba ya kupasha habari.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapoandika hotuba ya kupasha habari kuhusu suala linaloathiri jamii yao na kumsomea mzazi au mlezi wake.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapopewa nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani na katika kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis:
Mshikamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi kujadili ujumbe, lugha na muundo wa hotuba ya kupasha habari.
Elimu ya afya na kujikinga: mwanafunzi anapoandika hotuba ya kupasha habari kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha uandishi wa hotuba ya kupasha habari katika somo la Kiswahili na uandishi huo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la magonjwa ambukizi na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Integrated Science na Agriculture.

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya hotuba ya kupasha habari
kutambua hotuba ya kupasha habari katika matini
kueleza ujumbe, lugha na muundo wa hotuba ya kupasha habari
kuandika hotuba ya kupasha habari kwa kuzingatia ujumbe, lugha na muundo ufaao
kuchangamkia nafasi ya hotuba ya kupasha habari katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tambua na andika hotuba
skills.mastery: Tells hotuba from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes a speech with the itifaki, words spoken to the audience, facts the listener can use and a closing with thanks; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Speaking to inform comes before writing a speech to inform.
Formal written language of Grade 6.

misconceptions.error: Starts the speech with no greeting of the guests in order (itifaki).

example.question: Hotuba huanza vipi?
example.wrong_answer: moja kwa moja na hoja ya kwanza
example.correct_answer: kwa itifaki: Mheshimiwa mgeni rasmi, walimu, wazazi...

misconceptions.cause: The child writes a speech like an insha.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Hotuba huanza vipi?" with "moja kwa moja na hoja ya kwanza" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Model the itifaki line and the order of rank.
misconceptions.feedback: Hotuba huanza kwa itifaki.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes about the listeners in the third person instead of speaking to them (Wanafunzi wanapaswa... instead of Wanafunzi wenzangu, tunapaswa...).

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika hotuba?

misconceptions.cause: The speech is written, so it takes the voice of an essay.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika hotuba?" with "Wanafunzi wanapaswa kunawa mikono." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read the draft aloud to the class; change every "wao" to "sisi" or "nyinyi".
misconceptions.feedback: Hotuba huzungumza na hadhira moja kwa moja.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Ends without thanking the audience or closing (Asanteni kwa kunisikiliza).

example.question: Hotuba humalizika vipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child stops when the points run out.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Hotuba humalizika vipi?" with "kwa hoja ya mwisho tu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Model a closing: a call to act and thanks.
misconceptions.feedback: Funga hotuba kwa muhtasari na shukrani.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives an information speech with no facts the listener can use (dates, places, steps).

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika hotuba ya kupasha habari kuhusu chanjo dhidi ya surua?
example.correct_answer: Chanjo itatolewa katika zahanati ya Ruaka kuanzia Jumatatu ijayo.

misconceptions.cause: The child gives feelings, not information.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika hotuba ya kupasha habari kuhusu chanjo dhidi ya surua?" with "Ugonjwa huu ni mbaya sana." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Check the speech against nani, nini, lini, wapi, vipi.
misconceptions.feedback: Hotuba ya kupasha habari hutoa ukweli muhimu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Aina za Sentensi (Theme 12: Magonjwa ambukizi)
learning_experiences: kueleza maana ya sentensi sahili na ambatano,
kutenga sentensi sahili na ambatano katika orodha ya sentensi kwenye vitabu, chati au tarakilishi kwa kuzipigia mstari au kuzikolezea wino,
kutaja sentensi sahili na ambatano zinazojitokeza katika vifungu,
kuunganisha sentensi sahili mbili au zaidi kuunda sentensi ambatano
kuunda sentensi sahili kutokana na sentensi ambatano,
kutunga sentensi sahili na ambatano ipasavyo akizingatia masuala mtambuko mbalimbali likiwemo suala la magonjwa ambukizi,
kumtungia mzazi au mlezi sentensi sahili na ambatano zinazohusu shughuli katika mazingira ya nyumbani.
key_inquiry_questions: Ni aina gani ya sentensi unazozijua?
Je, sentensi sahili na ambatano hutofautianaje?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapotaja sentensi sahili na ambatano zinazojitokeza katika vifungu akiwa na wenzake.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali katika kutambua sentensi sahili na ambatano.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi kuhusu suala lengwa akitumia sentensi sahili na ambatano.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutambua sentensi sahili na ambatano katika kifungu.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapomtungia mzazi au mlezi wake sentensi sahili na ambatano zinazohusu shughuli katika mazingira ya nyumbani.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis:
Mshikamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi kutunga sentensi sahili na ambatano.
Magonjwa ambukizi: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahili na ambatano kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha aina za sentensi katika somo la Kiswahili na dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la magonjwa ambukizi na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Integrated Science na Agriculture.

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya sentensi sahili na ambatano
kutambua sentensi sahili na ambatano katika matini
kutunga sentensi sahili na ambatano ipasavyo
kuchangamkia matumizi ya sentensi sahili na ambatano katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tofautisha sentensi sahili na ambatano
skills.mastery: Mtoto hutambua sentensi sahili (wazo moja) na ambatano (mawazo mawili au zaidi yaliyounganishwa kwa kiunganishi). Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Joining words make compound sentences.

misconceptions.error: Thinks a compound sentence has one idea.

example.question: Sentensi ambatano ina nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "Wazo moja tu" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Sentensi ambatano huunganisha mawazo mawili au zaidi.
misconceptions.feedback: Sentensi ambatano huunganisha mawazo mawili au zaidi.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Does not see the conjunction.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ni ambatano?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "Mama anapika." next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Kiunganishi na huunganisha mawazo mawili.
misconceptions.feedback: Kiunganishi na huunganisha mawazo mawili.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Calls a long simple sentence compound.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ni sahili?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "Alikuja lakini aliondoka." next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Sentensi sahili ina wazo moja, hata ikiwa ndefu.
misconceptions.feedback: Sentensi sahili ina wazo moja, hata ikiwa ndefu.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Joins two full ideas with only a comma, no joining word (Mama alipika, baba alilima).

example.question: Unganisha vizuri: "Mama alipika. Baba alilima."

misconceptions.cause: In speech the pause joins them.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unganisha vizuri: "Mama alipika. Baba alilima."" with "Mama alipika, baba alilima." among the options.
misconceptions.help: A compound sentence needs a joining word between the two ideas.
misconceptions.feedback: Sentensi ambatano huunganishwa kwa kiunganishi: na, lakini, au.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Wahusika katika Nyimbo (Theme 13: Utatuzi wa mizozo)
learning_experiences: kusikiliza wimbo na kutambua wahusika katika wimbo huo (k.v. mwimbaji, hadhira lengwa na wahusika wengine kwenye wimbo),
kuchambua wahusika katika wimbo aliousikiliza,
kusikiliza na kuimba wimbo katika vifaa vya kidijitali kuhusu suala lengwa akiwa na wenzake huku akichukua nafasi mbalimbali (k.v. mwimbaji au hadhira),
kusikiliza wimbo katika vifaa vya kidijitali na kueleza mafunzo kutokana na wahusika katika wimbo huo,
kutunga wimbo kuhusu mada lengwa na kuwawasilishia wenzake ili kuchanganua wahusika,
kushirikiana na mzazi au mlezi kuchanganua wahusika katika nyimbo mbalimbali kutoka kwa jamii yake.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, wahusika katika wimbo wana majukumu gani?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi na kuchambua wahusika kwa njia wazi akiwa na wenzake.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusikilizia nyimbo.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga wimbo kuhusu suala lengwa na kuwawasilishia wenzake.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapochanganua wahusika na nafasi zao katika wimbo.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapowawasilishia wenzake wimbo alioutunga.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani na katika kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi na kutunza vifaa vya kidijitali anavyotumia.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis:
Utatuzi wa mizozo: mwanafunzi anapoimba nyimbo kuhusu suala lengwa.
Masuala ya kijamii: mwanafunzi anapoimba nyimbo kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya wahusika katika nyimbo ya somo la Kiswahili na dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la utatuzi wa mizozo na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua wahusika katika wimbo
kuchambua wahusika katika wimbo
kueleza mafunzo kutokana na wahusika katika wimbo
kufurahia kushiriki katika uchanganuzi wa wahusika katika nyimbo

skills.name: Chambua wahusika katika nyimbo
skills.mastery: Explains the wahusika of nyimbo (wimbo wa kazi, wimbo wa watoto) with the right terms and examples, gives evidence or a reason for each point, and presents one with its formula, voice, gestures and audience part (presentation scored by the teacher), in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: The kinds of songs come before their characters.
Grade 6 found characters and their traits in a play.

misconceptions.error: Names a character who only appears once as the main one.

example.question: Mhusika mkuu katika nyimbo hii ni nani?

misconceptions.cause: The child picks the most striking name.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mhusika mkuu katika nyimbo hii ni nani?" with "mhusika aliyetajwa mara moja" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask whom the whole text is about.
misconceptions.feedback: Mhusika mkuu ni yule ambaye utungo unamhusu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives a trait with no line or action as evidence.

example.question: Sungura ni mpatanishi. Thibitisha.

misconceptions.cause: Naming the trait feels like the answer.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Sungura ni mpatanishi. Thibitisha." with "kwa sababu ni mzuri" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Frame: sifa + kwa sababu + action.
misconceptions.feedback: Thibitisha sifa kwa kitendo au maneno ya mhusika.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes an animal character literally, not as standing for people (Sungura is just a hare).

example.question: Katika nyimbo, Sungura anawakilisha nini?
example.correct_answer: watu wenye tabia kama zake katika jamii

misconceptions.cause: Animal characters look like animal facts.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Katika nyimbo, Sungura anawakilisha nini?" with "mnyama wa porini tu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask which people in the community behave like this character.
misconceptions.feedback: Wahusika wanyama huwakilisha tabia za watu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Draws the wrong lesson from a character (copy the trickster because he won).

example.question: Tunajifunza nini kutokana na mhusika mjanja aliyeadhibiwa mwishoni?

misconceptions.cause: The trick is remembered; the ending is not.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Tunajifunza nini kutokana na mhusika mjanja aliyeadhibiwa mwishoni?" with "tuwe wajanja ili tushinde" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Trace the character to the end: what did he gain and lose?
misconceptions.feedback: Funzo hutokana na matokeo ya matendo ya mhusika.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Kina (Theme 13: Utatuzi wa mizozo)
learning_experiences: kueleza maana ya mbinu za lugha katika fasihi,
kutambua mbinu za lugha (k.v. tashbihi, sitiari, nahau, methali, tasfida na tanakali za sauti) katika novela iliyoteuliwa na mwalimu,
kueleza umuhimu wa mbinu za lugha zilizotumiwa katika novela iliyoteuliwa na mwalimu,
kuhakiki uwasilishaji wa wenzake na kutoa maoni,
kufanya utafiti maktabani au mtandaoni kuhusu matumizi ya mbinu za lugha katika novela,
kumtajia mzazi au mlezi matumizi ya mbinu za lugha katika novela aliyosoma.
key_inquiry_questions: Mbinu za lugha zina umuhimu gani zinapotumiwa katika kazi za fasihi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kutambua mbinu za lugha kwenye novela aliyosoma akiwa na wenzake katika kikundi.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapowawasilishia wenzake muhtasari wa matumizi ya mbinu za lugha katika novela kwa kutetea hoja zake.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapofanya utafiti maktabani na mtandaoni kuhusu matumizi ya mbinu za lugha katika novela.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapotangamana na wenzake katika kikundi kujadili mbinu za lugha katika novela huku akiheshimu maoni yao.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapohakiki uwasilishaji wa wenzake huku akiwakosoa kwa upendo na kuwahimiza.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojiandaa ipasavyo ili kuwawasilishia wenzake kazi yake. Pia anapochukua hatua ya kutafiti kuhusu matumizi ya mbinu za lugha maktabani au mtandaoni.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis: anuwai: mwanafunzi anapoeleza ujumbe katika novela.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha mbinu za lugha katika novela ya Kiswahili na mbinu hizo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la utatuzi wa mizozo na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies.

kutambua mbinu za lugha katika novela

kufurahia kuchanganua matumizi ya mbinu za lugha katika fasihi

skills.name: Tambua mbinu za lugha na umuhimu wake katika novela
skills.mastery: Explains the mbinu of a novela read in class ("Kisima cha Matumaini") with a correct term, gives evidence from the text for every point, and says why it matters to the work, in 8 of 10 new items (longer written answers marked by the teacher).

prerequisites.reason: Characters are often drawn with devices.
Grade 6 sitiari.

misconceptions.error: Calls a comparison with kama a sitiari, or one without kama a tashbihi.

example.question: "Bwana Tajiri ni fisi" ni mbinu gani?

misconceptions.cause: Both compare; the child has not fixed which one uses kama, mithili ya or kana kwamba.
misconceptions.reveals: The question ""Bwana Tajiri ni fisi" ni mbinu gani?" with "tashbihi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Circle kama, mithili ya, kana kwamba: present means tashbihi; absent means sitiari.
misconceptions.feedback: Tashbihi hulinganisha kwa kama au mithili ya; sitiari hulinganisha moja kwa moja.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Names the device but cannot say what it does in the work.

example.question: Mbinu ya sitiari katika "Bwana Tajiri ni fisi" ina umuhimu gani?

misconceptions.cause: Devices have been taught as labels to find.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mbinu ya sitiari katika "Bwana Tajiri ni fisi" ina umuhimu gani?" with "ni sitiari" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Always add "inasaidia..." after the label: picture, feeling, stress, humour.
misconceptions.feedback: Eleza kazi ya mbinu: inajenga picha, inasisitiza, inaonyesha hisia.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads a figure of speech literally.

example.question: "Bwana Tajiri ni fisi" ina maana gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child reads the words, not the picture.
misconceptions.reveals: The question ""Bwana Tajiri ni fisi" ina maana gani?" with "maana ya maneno kama yalivyo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask: is this really true? If not, what does the writer want us to see?
misconceptions.feedback: Lugha ya picha haina maana ya moja kwa moja.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Does not notice repetition (takriri) or rhetorical questions as devices.

example.question: "Nitarudi, nitarudi, nitarudi!" ni mbinu gani?

misconceptions.cause: Repetition looks like a mistake to a child taught not to repeat words.
misconceptions.reveals: The question ""Nitarudi, nitarudi, nitarudi!" ni mbinu gani?" with "kosa la uchapishaji" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read the line aloud; what feeling does the repetition add?
misconceptions.feedback: Takriri ni kurudia neno au kifungu ili kusisitiza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Insha za Kubuni (Theme 13: Utatuzi wa mizozo)
learning_experiences: kutambua mambo ya kimsingi katika uandishi wa insha ya maelezo,
kuandaa vidokezo vya insha ya maelezo kuhusu sura na matendo ya mtu anayelengwa katika insha hiyo,

kuandika daftarini au katika kifaa cha kidijitali insha ya maelezo inayotoa sifa za mtu akizingatia muundo ufaao na inayohusisha suala lengwa kisha awasomee wenzake darasani au awasambazie wenzake mtandaoni ili waitolee maoni,
kutolea insha za wenzake maoni kwa upendo.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, insha ya maelezo inahusu nini?
Je, ni vigezo vipi vinatumika katika kuandika insha ya maelezo?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi kujadiliana kuhusu insha ya maelezo.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kuandika insha ya maelezo na kuisambaza mtandaoni.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya maelezo kwa muundo ufaao.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapobuni na kusambaza insha kwa wenzake.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapotolea insha za wenzake maoni.
sub_strands.pcis: anuwai: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha uandishi wa insha ya maelezo katika somo la Kiswahili na dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la utatuzi wa mizozo na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua mambo ya kimsingi katika uandishi wa insha ya maelezo
kuandika insha ya maelezo inayodhihirisha sifa za mtu
kuchangamkia kutoa maelezo kamilifu kuhusu kitu au jambo

skills.name: Andika insha ya maelezo inayodhihirisha sifa za mtu
skills.mastery: Tells insha ya wasifu from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes a description of a person, place or thing with describing words that agree with their nouns and no story of events; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Theme 11 ordered a maelezo.
Grade 6 wasifu of a person.

misconceptions.error: Tells a story of what happened where the insha should describe the person, place or thing.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya wasifu kuhusu "Mpatanishi wa Kijiji Chetu"?
example.correct_answer: Mzee Kiprono, mwenye sauti tulivu na macho ya upole, husikiliza pande zote kabla ya kusema neno.

misconceptions.cause: Stories are the kind of writing the child has done most and he falls back on it.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya wasifu kuhusu "Mpatanishi wa Kijiji Chetu"?" with "Siku moja tulienda sokoni tukapotea." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask what the reader should know about the topic at the end: what it looks like, what it is for.
misconceptions.feedback: Insha ya wasifu hueleza jinsi kitu au mtu alivyo, si matukio ya siku moja.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Describes with empty words (kizuri sana, kibaya) and no detail that makes a picture.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Mpatanishi wa Kijiji Chetu"?
example.correct_answer: Mzee Kiprono, mwenye sauti tulivu na macho ya upole, husikiliza pande zote kabla ya kusema neno.

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the thing well and assumes the reader sees it too.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Mpatanishi wa Kijiji Chetu"?" with "Mzee Kiprono ni mzuri." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Five senses chart: what do you see, hear, smell, touch, taste? Turn one row into a sentence.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia vivumishi na maelezo ya rangi, umbo, ukubwa na sauti ili msomaji aone picha.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses a describing word that does not agree with its noun (bendera mzuri, miti mrefu).

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ni sahihi?

misconceptions.cause: The child uses one form of the adjective (m-) for every noun, as he hears it for people.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ni sahihi?" with "Ana tabia mwema." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Find the noun first, then its ngeli, then the prefix of the adjective.
misconceptions.feedback: Kivumishi hupatana na nomino yake: bendera nzuri, miti mirefu, mtoto mzuri.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts in points that are not about the title.

example.question: Katika insha ya wasifu yenye anwani "Mpatanishi wa Kijiji Chetu", ni sentensi ipi haifai?
example.wrong_answer: Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu.
example.correct_answer: Mzee Kiprono, mwenye sauti tulivu na macho ya upole, husikiliza pande zote kabla ya kusema neno.

misconceptions.cause: The child adds whatever he remembers so the insha is long enough.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Katika insha ya wasifu yenye anwani "Mpatanishi wa Kijiji Chetu", ni sentensi ipi haifai?" with "Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read each sentence and ask: does it tell the reader about the title? Cross out the ones that do not.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila sentensi ya insha inapaswa kuhusu anwani.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes in plain, flat words with no language devices (tashbihi, sitiari, methali, nahau) to make the insha vivid.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ina lugha ya kiubunifu kwa insha "Mpatanishi wa Kijiji Chetu"?
example.correct_answer: Mzee Kiprono, mwenye sauti tulivu na macho ya upole, husikiliza pande zote kabla ya kusema neno.

misconceptions.cause: The child has not been shown how devices from fasihi can be used in his own writing.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ina lugha ya kiubunifu kwa insha "Mpatanishi wa Kijiji Chetu"?" with "Mzee Kiprono ni mzuri." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Collect three devices from a class reader; rewrite one plain sentence with each.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia tashbihi, sitiari, methali au nahau kufanya insha iwe hai.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Ukanushaji kwa Kuzingatia Nyakati (Theme 13: Utatuzi wa mizozo)
learning_experiences: kueleza maana ya ukanushaji,
kutambua nyakati tatu tofauti (uliopita, uliopo, ujao) kutoka kwenye chati, mti maneno, vitabu au vifaa vya kidijitali,
kutambua ukanushaji wa sentensi katika wakati uliopita, uliopo na ujao,
kukanusha sentensi alizopewa katika wakati uliopita, uliopo na ujao,
kutunga sentensi au vifungu vifupi kwa kutumia wakati uliopita, uliopo na ujao na kuzikanusha akizingatia masuala mtambuko mbalimbali likiwemo suala la utatuzi wa mizozo,
kuwasilisha kazi yake darasani au kuwasambazia wenzake mtandaoni ili kuitolea maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Tunakanusha sentensi kwa kuzingatia nyakati gani?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki kikamilifu katika kazi za kikundi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali katika kutambua ukanushaji kwa kuzingatia nyakati.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi kuonyesha ukanushaji wa nyakati.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutambua ukanushaji wa nyakati na kuutungia sentensi sahihi.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis: Mshikamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya ukanushaji katika somo la Kiswahili na dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la utatuzi wa mizozo na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies.

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya ukanushaji
kutambua wakati uliopita, uliopo na ujao katika matini
kutambua ukanushaji kwa kuzingatia wakati uliopita, uliopo na ujao katika matini
kutumia ipasavyo hali ya ukanushaji wa wakati uliopita, uliopo na ujao katika matini
kuchangamkia kukanusha sentensi katika wakati uliopita, uliopo na ujao ili kukuza mawasiliano

skills.name: Kanusha sentensi katika nyakati tatu
skills.mastery: Mtoto hukanusha sentensi katika wakati uliopo (hasomi), uliopita (hakusoma) na ujao (hatasoma). Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Grade 5 negation by person and tense.

misconceptions.error: Negates the present with ha-ku-.

example.question: Kanusha: Anasoma.

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "Hakusoma" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Ukanushaji wa uliopo ni hasomi.
misconceptions.feedback: Ukanushaji wa uliopo ni hasomi.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Negates the past without -ku-.

example.question: Kanusha: Alisoma.

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "Hasomi" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Ukanushaji wa uliopita ni hakusoma.
misconceptions.feedback: Ukanushaji wa uliopita ni hakusoma.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Negates the future wrongly.

example.question: Kanusha: Atasoma.

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "Hakusoma" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Ukanushaji wa ujao ni hatasoma.
misconceptions.feedback: Ukanushaji wa ujao ni hatasoma.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Negates -me- with -ku- (hakusoma for hajasoma), mixing the past and the perfect.

example.question: Kanusha: "Amesoma kitabu."

misconceptions.cause: Both -li- and -me- feel like "past".
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kanusha: "Amesoma kitabu."" with "Hakusoma kitabu." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Pair them: -li- -> -ku- (hakusoma); -me- -> -ja- (hajasoma: not yet).
misconceptions.feedback: -me- hukanushwa kwa -ja-: hajasoma.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Lugha katika Nyimbo (Theme 14: Matumizi ya pesa)
learning_experiences: kutambua vipengele vya lugha kwa kusikiliza nyimbo kuhusu suala lengwa kutoka kwa mwalimu, kwenye maandishi (k.v. vitabu na chati) au vifaa vya kidijitali,
kujadili umuhimu wa vipengele vya lugha vilivyotumika katika nyimbo alizozisikiliza,
kutunga wimbo unaohusiana na suala lengwa akizingatia vipengele vya lugha katika nyimbo,
kushirikiana na mzazi au mlezi wake kusikiliza nyimbo katika jamii yake na kutambua vipengele vya lugha katika nyimbo.
key_inquiry_questions: Nyimbo hutumia vipengele gani vya lugha?
Kutumia vipengele mbalimbali vya lugha katika wimbo kuna umuhimu gani?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapotambua vipengele vya lugha katika nyimbo wakiwa na wenzake katika kikundi.

Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga wimbo na kuzingatia vipengele vya lugha.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapojadili na wenzake katika kikundi vipengele vya lugha katika nyimbo kwa njia wazi.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na mzazi au mlezi wake kusikiliza nyimbo na kutambua vipengele vya lugha vilivyotumika.

Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi.

Elimu ya kifedha: mwanafunzi anapotunga nyimbo kuhusu suala lengwa.

skills.name: Tambua vipengele vya lugha katika nyimbo
skills.mastery: Explains the lugha of nyimbo (wimbo wa kazi, wimbo wa watoto) with the right terms and examples, gives evidence or a reason for each point, and presents one with its formula, voice, gestures and audience part (presentation scored by the teacher), in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: The characters of songs were analysed in Theme 13.
Grade 6 sitiari: a device of language.

misconceptions.error: Does not see a device of language (repetition, simile, sound words) or calls it a mistake.

example.question: "senti senti hujaza kibubu" ni kipengele gani cha lugha?

misconceptions.cause: The child has been told not to repeat words or use sounds in writing.
misconceptions.reveals: The question ""senti senti hujaza kibubu" ni kipengele gani cha lugha?" with "kosa la lugha" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read aloud; what does the device add for the listener?
misconceptions.feedback: Ni takriri na methali: husisitiza kuweka akiba kidogo kidogo
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads a figure of speech literally.

example.question: "senti senti hujaza kibubu" ina maana gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child reads words, not pictures.
misconceptions.reveals: The question ""senti senti hujaza kibubu" ina maana gani?" with "maana ya maneno kama yalivyo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask: is this really true? If not, what is meant?
misconceptions.feedback: Lugha ya picha ina maana iliyofichika.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Names a device but cannot say why it matters (it makes the text nice).

example.question: Kipengele cha takriri na methali kina umuhimu gani?

misconceptions.cause: Devices are taught as labels.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kipengele cha takriri na methali kina umuhimu gani?" with "kinapamba tu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Always add what it does: picture, rhythm, memory, stress, feeling.
misconceptions.feedback: Eleza kazi ya kipengele: kinasisitiza, kinajenga picha, kinaburudisha.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Does not see the call-and-response or the audience's part as part of the language.

example.question: Msikilizaji anaposema "Tega!" au kuitikia wimbo, hiyo ni nini?
example.correct_answer: ushirikishaji wa hadhira, sehemu ya utungo

misconceptions.cause: Written texts have no audience part.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Msikilizaji anaposema "Tega!" au kuitikia wimbo, hiyo ni nini?" with "kelele zisizo na maana" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Perform it in class with and without the response; what is lost?
misconceptions.feedback: Fasihi simulizi huishirikisha hadhira.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Insha ya Maelekezo (Theme 14: Matumizi ya pesa)
learning_experiences: kubainisha sifa za insha ya maelekezo kwa kuzingatia vielelezo vya insha kwenye matini za kimaandishi au za kidijitali (k.v. usahihi wa habari, mpangilio wa maelezo wenye mantiki, lugha sahili na maelezo yanayotoka upande mmoja),
kujadili na wenzake aina za insha za maelekezo,
kushiriki katika kikundi kujadili mpangilio ufaao wa hatua za kuelekeza,
kuandaa mpangilio wa hatua za insha ya maelekezo,
kuandika insha ya maelekezo akizingatia anwani na mpangilio mwafaka wa hatua huku akitumia vipengele vya lugha vinavyotumiwa kuelekeza ili kumjengea msomaji taswira kamili ya anachoelekezwa kufanya,
kuwasomea wenzake katika kikundi insha aliyoandika darasani au awasambazie kwenye vifaa vya kidijitali ili waitolee maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Utatumia mpangilio gani wa kumwelekeza mtu asipotee njia?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki na wenzake katika kujadili kuhusu anwani na hatua katika kielelezo cha insha ya maelekezo waliyosoma.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusambaza insha.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoteua lugha mwafaka na kufaulu kutoa maelezo bayana ya anachoelekeza.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapowasomea wenzake insha aliyoandika ili waitolee maoni.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kuwasomea wenzake insha hadharani.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapopewa nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani na katika kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis:
Elimu ya kifedha: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi kusahihisha insha ya maelezo na wenzake na kujifunza ukakamavu, stahamala na kujiamini.
Ukadiriaji wa matumizi ya pesa: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya maelekezo kuhusu suala kuu.

sub_strands.sub_strand: Ukubwa wa Nomino (Theme 14: Matumizi ya pesa)
learning_experiences: kutambua nomino katika hali ya ukubwa (k.v. jitu, joka, jiji, kapu, goma, jisu na jishamba) kwenye orodha ya nomino, chati, kadi maneno, kapu maneno, sentensi, vifungu vya maneno au tarakilishi,
kutambua viambishi vya ukubwa katika maneno,
kuandika majina ya vifaa vya darasani katika ukubwa,
kuambatanisha nomino za hali ya wastani na za hali ya ukubwa kwa usahihi,
kubadilisha nomino za hali ya wastani ziwe katika hali ya ukubwa,
kujaza nafasi katika sentensi au vifungu kwa kutumia nomino katika hali ya ukubwa ipasavyo,
kutunga sentensi au vifungu vifupi akitumia nomino katika hali ya ukubwa akizingatia masuala mtambuko mbalimbali likiwemo suala la matumizi ya pesa,
kuwasilisha kazi yake darasani ili wenzake waitathmini,
kumtajia mzazi au mlezi majina ya vifaa vya nyumbani katika ukubwa (k.v. jimeza, jijiko na jisahani).
key_inquiry_questions: Unazingatia nini unapoandika nomino katika ukubwa?

Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi kuhusu suala lengwa akitumia nomino katika hali ya ukubwa.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapomtajia mzazi au mlezi wake nomino katika hali ya ukubwa katika mazingira ya nyumbani.

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusikiliza Habari na Kujibu (Theme 15: Maadili ya mtu binafsi)
learning_experiences: kutambua masuala yanayoshughulikiwa katika matini kuhusu suala lengwa,
kutambua msamiati wa suala lengwa uliotumiwa katika matini alizosikiliza kutoka kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali, mwalimu au mgeni mwalikwa,
kutabiri kitakachotokea au atakachofanya mhusika kutoka kwenye matini aliyosikiliza kwa kuzingatia vidokezo (k.v. anwani na picha) anavyopatana navyo katika usikilizaji,
kueleza maana za msamiati wa suala lengwa kama ulivyotumiwa katika matini aliyosikiliza,
kusikiliza matini kuhusu suala lengwa kutoka kwa mwalimu au mgeni mwalikwa na kufasiri wazo kuu katika habari hiyo,
kusikiliza habari kwenye vifaa vya kidijitali (k.v. kinasasauti) kuhusu suala lengwa na kutaja masuala yanayoshughulikiwa,
kushirikiana na mzazi au mlezi kutafiti kwenye tovuti salama kuhusu maadili ya mtu binafsi na kutambua suala kuu au masuala makuu katika matini.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni mambo gani yanayokuelekeza kufasiri suala muhimu katika habari unayosikiliza?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kikundi na kuchangia kutambua na kueleza maana za msamiati wa suala lengwa katika matini aliyosikiliza.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusikilizia habari na kujibu kulingana na maagizo.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anaposikiliza matini ipasavyo na anapochangia katika shughuli za kikundi.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki shughuli ya kusikiliza kwa ufahamu na mzazi au mlezi wake na kujifunza maarifa ya kuwasilisha habari kuhusu maadili ya mtu binafsi.
sub_strands.values:

Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowasikiliza wasemaji kwa makini. Pia anapowapa wanafunzi wenzake zamu ya kuzungumza.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali anavyotumia katika mazungumzo.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za kikundi. ya mtu binafsi: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kusikiliza na kujibu mazungumzo kuhusu suala lengwa.
